1.title: Grammar Auction: 12 tenses revision
1.stage: 12 zamon jadvali tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
1.goal: Vaqt ko'rsatkichiga qarab zamonni to'g'ri tanlash: holat fe'llari, for/since, Past Perfect, Future Perfect, fakt uchun Present Simple; xato zamonni tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000. 12 zamon jadvali doskada ko'rinib tursin.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: zamon to'g'ri tanlanganmi (vaqt ko'rsatkichi, holat fe'li, for/since)?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri zamonga o'tkazib tuzatgan va zamon nomini aytgan jamoa +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: I have been learning English for three years.
items.why: for + davr, hozirgacha davom etayotgan jarayon: Present Perfect Continuous.

items.s: I am knowing the answer to this question.
items.fix: I know the answer to this question.
items.why: know — holat fe'li, Continuous shaklda ishlatilmaydi.

items.s: By the time we arrived, the lesson had already started.
items.why: Boshqa o'tgan ishdan oldin tugagan ish: Past Perfect (had + V3).

items.s: She has studied at this school since two years.
items.fix: She has studied at this school for two years.
items.why: Davr (two years) bilan 'for', boshlanish nuqtasi (2022) bilan 'since'.

items.s: Look! The students take notes on their laptops.
items.fix: Look! The students are taking notes on their laptops.
items.why: Look! — ish ayni paytda bo'lyapti: Present Continuous (are + V-ing).

items.s: When the teacher came in, we were going over our notes.
items.why: Davom etayotgan jarayon (were going over) paytida qisqa ish bo'ldi (came in): Past Continuous + Past Simple.

items.s: A dictionary is giving the meanings of words.
items.fix: A dictionary gives the meanings of words.
items.why: Doimiy, umumiy fakt: Present Simple (gives); Continuous faqat ayni paytdagi jarayon uchun.

items.s: This time tomorrow, we will be sitting the IELTS exam.
items.why: Kelajakdagi aniq paytda davom etadigan jarayon: Future Continuous.

items.s: I have finished the course last year.
items.fix: I finished the course last year.
items.why: last year — aniq o'tgan vaqt: Past Simple; Present Perfect bilan ishlatilmaydi.

items.s: She was tired because she had been studying all night.
items.why: O'tgan nuqtagacha davom etgan jarayon: Past Perfect Continuous.

items.s: By June, I will already learn 500 new words.
items.fix: By June, I will already have learned 500 new words.
items.why: by + kelajak nuqta, o'sha paytgacha tugaydigan ish: Future Perfect (will have + V3).

items.s: We have already gone over the twelve tenses twice.
items.why: already + natija hozir muhim: Present Perfect (have + V3).

1.title: Board Game: 12 tenses on the way to IELTS
1.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin yoki 2-dars boshida takror sifatida (20 daqiqa)
1.goal: 12 zamonni tanib olish, fe'lni vaqt ko'rsatkichiga mos zamonga qo'yish, xatoni tuzatish va o'qish odatlari haqida turli zamonlarda gapirish.
rules: Har 3–4 o'quvchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
O'quvchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: zamonni nomlaydi, fe'lni to'g'ri zamonga qo'yadi yoki to'liq gap aytadi.
Guruh javobni kalit bilan tekshiradi (kalit guruh sardorida). Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi katagiga qaytadi.
'Talk for 20/30 seconds' kataklarida kamida 3 gap aytiladi va topshiriqda ko'rsatilgan zamon ishlatiladi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.
materials: 12 zamon jadvali doskada qolsin (qiynalganlar uchun yordam)

squares.a: Past Continuous

squares.a: e.g. I usually study after dinner and I take notes in a notebook.

squares.t: Correct: I am knowing the answer.
squares.a: I know the answer.

squares.t: Complete: She has studied here ___ 2022 / ___ two years.
squares.a: since / for

squares.t: Complete: While I ___ (study), my brother was playing games.
squares.a: was studying

squares.t: Name the tense: I will have finished the book by Friday.
squares.a: Future Perfect

squares.a: e.g. How long have you been learning English?

squares.t: Correct: He is reading books every day.
squares.a: He reads books every day.

squares.t: Say what you did yesterday to learn English (Past Simple).
squares.a: e.g. I looked up ten new words and did my homework.

squares.t: Complete: This time tomorrow we ___ (sit) the test.
squares.a: will be sitting

squares.t: Name the tense: She had been revising for five hours.
squares.a: Past Perfect Continuous

squares.a: By the time I arrived, the lesson had started.

squares.a: had memorized

squares.a: e.g. I will revise tonight. At 9 p.m. I will be doing my homework.

squares.a: I will have learned 500 words by June.

squares.a: will have been learning (also: will have learned)

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: how your English has changed (Present Perfect).
squares.a: e.g. I have learned a lot of words and I have become more confident.

squares.t: Describe your English with 4 different tenses.
squares.a: e.g. I study… / I'm learning… / I've passed… / I'll take IELTS.

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: your IELTS plan (will / will have + V3).
squares.a: e.g. By next summer I will have taken IELTS, and then I will apply to a university.

1.title: Dominoes: match the sentence to its tense
1.stage: 'YANGI MAVZU' (12 zamon jadvali) bosqichidan keyin, Kombinatsiya o'rnida (12 daqiqa)
1.goal: Gapdagi zamonni aniqlash va uni formulasi bilan bog'lash: 12 zamonning hammasi (Simple, Continuous, Perfect, Perfect Continuous × Present/Past/Future).
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshidan boshlang: toshning o'ng tomonidagi gapni o'qing va uning zamoni (formulasi bilan) yozilgan toshni toping — u chap tomonda turadi.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulang: har gap o'z zamoniga ulanadi, zanjir FINISH bilan tugaydi. 12 zamonning har biri bir marta uchraydi.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh har gapni va uning zamonini ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: She reviews her notes every evening.
Present Simple (V1 / V1 + s)
Look! He is taking notes on his phone.
Present Continuous (am/is/are + V-ing)
I have already handed in my essay.
Present Perfect (have/has + V3)
We have been doing group study since 9 a.m.
Present Perfect Continuous (have/has been + V-ing)
Aziz dropped out of the course in 2020.
Past Simple (V2)
At 8 p.m. yesterday we were going over the tenses.
Past Continuous (was/were + V-ing)
By 10 a.m. the exam had already started.
Past Perfect (had + V3)
By noon she had been revising for five hours.
Past Perfect Continuous (had been + V-ing)
I will look up the new words tonight.
Future Simple (will + V1)
This time tomorrow I will be sitting the test.
Future Continuous (will be + V-ing)
By June we will have finished the course.
Future Perfect (will have + V3)
By May I will have been studying here for a year.
Future Perfect Continuous (will have been + V-ing)

1.title: Taboo: learning and study words
1.goal: Learning mavzusidagi so'z va iboralarni (note-taking, curriculum, lifelong learning, drop out, brush up on…) inglizcha tushuntirib berish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida kartadagi so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Tushuntirishda turli zamonlardan foydalanish tavsiya etiladi: 'You do it when…', 'I did it before my exam…', 'I have never done it…'.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball. Taqiqlangan so'z yoki o'zbekcha so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

1.title: Find someone who… has been learning English for years
1.stage: Dars o'rtasida harakatli mashq, Reading bosqichidan oldin (10 daqiqa)
1.goal: Turli zamonlarda savol tuzish (Are you…? Did you…? Have you ever…? Have you been…? Had you…? Will you be…? Will you have…?) va o'qish haqida javob berish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
Har qator uchun savolni o'quvchi o'zi tuzadi va gapdagi zamonni saqlaydi (masalan: '…has been learning' → 'Have you been learning…?').
'Yes' degan sinfdoshning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When? How long? Why?).
Bitta ismni ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozish mumkin; o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni to'liq gap bilan aytadi; ustoz savollarni kalit bilan tekshiradi.

items.t: …is reading an interesting book at the moment.
items.q: Are you reading an interesting book at the moment?

items.t: …has been learning English for more than three years.
items.q: Have you been learning English for more than three years?

items.t: …will be doing homework at 8 o'clock tonight.
items.q: Will you be doing your homework at 8 o'clock tonight?

items.t: …will have finished school by 2027.
items.q: Will you have finished school by 2027?

items.t: …has been using a language app this month.

items.q: Do you set aside an hour a day for reading?

items.t: …thinks he/she will study abroad one day.

1.title: Speaking cards: my learning story
1.stage: 'Writing / speaking mini-vazifa' bosqichida — og'zaki variant, IELTS Speaking Part 1 uslubi (12 daqiqa)
1.goal: O'qish odatlari va ta'lim haqida 3–4 gapli javob berish; savoldagi zamonni to'g'ri ishlatish va Learning lug'atini qo'llash.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi 30–45 soniya javob beradi: kamida 3 gap, savoldagi zamon albatta ishlatiladi (masalan, 'How long have you been…?' → have been + V-ing).
Tinglovchi ball beradi: har bir to'g'ri ishlatilgan boshqa zamon +1, Learning lug'atidan har so'z +1.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: How long have you been learning English, and why did you start?
What study habits do you have? Describe a normal study day.
What were you doing at this time yesterday?

Describe a subject you found difficult at school. How did you overcome the challenge?
What will you be doing this time next year?
What will you have achieved by the end of this year?
Do you prefer online learning or lessons in a classroom? Why?
How do you usually prepare for an examination?
Have you ever taught something to a friend? What was it?
Which study techniques have worked best for you so far?
Do you take notes on paper or on a device? Why?
Is lifelong learning important? What would you like to learn when you are older?
When did you last look up a word in a dictionary? What was it?
How has the way you study changed since you were a child?

1.title: Sentence Race: the 12 tenses in sentences
1.stage: 'Xatolar ustida ishlash + takror' bosqichida yoki uyga vazifadan oldin (8 daqiqa)
1.goal: Turli zamondagi gaplarda so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish (yordamchi fe'l + asosiy fe'l, vaqt ko'rsatkichi) va zamonni nomlash.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va gap qaysi zamonda ekanini aytadi.
Yordam: gapning birinchi so'zi katta harf bilan, oxirgi so'zi nuqta, so'roq yoki undov belgisi bilan yozilgan.
Ustoz tekshiradi: tartib va zamon nomi to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball, jamoa keyingi konvertni oladi.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: She reviews her notes every evening before bed.
Right now, the students are taking notes on laptops.
Have you ever taken an online course?
I have been learning English for three years.
I was taking notes when my phone rang.
By the time we arrived, the lesson had already started.
She was tired because she had been studying all night.
This time tomorrow we will be sitting the final test.
By June, I will have finished this course.
By 2030, my sister will have been teaching for ten years.

1.title: Quiz Board: 12 tenses and learning words
1.stage: Dars oxiridagi umumiy takror yoki 2-dars boshida, Kahootdan keyin (15 daqiqa)
1.goal: 12 zamonni aniqlash, zamon xatolarini tuzatish, Learning lug'ati (ta'rif → so'z) va zamonlar bilan og'zaki gap tuzishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 ustun (Name the tense, Correct it, Learning words, Say it!) va 100–500 ballar.
Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Correct it 300'). Ustoz savolni o'qiydi.
Jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. To'g'ri — ball jamoaga; xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
'Say it!' savollarida javob to'liq gap bo'lishi va kerakli zamon ishlatilishi shart.
Ishlatilgan katak o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

2.title: Grammar Auction: used to / be used to / get used to
2.stage: 'YANGI MAVZU' (used to / be used to) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
2.goal: used to + V1 (o'tgan odat) va be/get used to + V-ing/ot (o'rganib qolgan) qoliplarini ajratish; use to / used to, V1 / V-ing xatolarini tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000. Doskaga ikki qolipni yozing: used to + V1 | be/get used to + V-ing.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: qolip va fe'l shakli to'g'rimi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan va qoidani aytgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'be used to dan keyin V-ing').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: My grandfather used to write letters to his brother.
items.why: O'tgan, hozir yo'q odat: used to + V1 (write).

items.s: I use to play computer games every day when I was ten.
items.fix: I used to play computer games every day when I was ten.
items.why: Tasdiq gapda 'used to' (-d bilan); 'use to' faqat did bilan keladi.

items.s: My mum is getting used to online banking.
items.why: get used to + ot: o'rganib borish jarayoni.

items.s: I am used to play games on my phone.
items.fix: I am used to playing games on my phone.
items.why: be used to dan keyin V-ing keladi: bu yerda 'to' — predlog.

items.s: We didn't use to have smart devices at home.
items.why: Inkor: didn't use to + V1 (use — -d siz).

items.s: Did you used to have a Nokia phone?
items.fix: Did you use to have a Nokia phone?
items.why: Savolda Did bor — 'use to' (-d siz).

items.s: Are you used to working on a laptop?
items.why: Savol: Be + S + used to + V-ing.

items.s: People are used to send letters before email appeared.
items.fix: People used to send letters before email appeared.
items.why: O'tgan, hozir yo'q odat: used to + V1; 'are used to' emas.

items.s: My grandmother isn't used to smart devices yet.
items.why: be used to + ot ham bo'ladi: hali o'rganmagan (smart devices).

items.s: Years ago, my dad used to backing up his files on CDs.
items.fix: Years ago, my dad used to back up his files on CDs.
items.why: O'tgan, hozir yo'q odat: used to + V1 (back up), V-ing emas.

items.s: It took me a month to get used to my new phone.
items.why: get used to + ot: o'rganib olish jarayoni (bir oy davom etgan).

items.s: My dad didn't used to like smartphones.
items.fix: My dad didn't use to like smartphones.
items.why: Inkorda didn't bor — 'use to' (-d siz).

2.title: Board Game: Then and now
2.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin yoki 3-dars boshida takror sifatida (20 daqiqa)
2.goal: used to / didn't use to / Did…use to? va be/get used to + V-ing shakllarini og'zaki ishlatish; texnologiya 'oldin va hozir' haqida gapirish.
rules: Har 3–4 o'quvchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
O'quvchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: bo'shliqni to'ldiradi, xatoni tuzatadi yoki to'liq gap aytadi.
Guruh javobni kalit bilan tekshiradi (kalit guruh sardorida): used to dan keyin V1, be/get used to dan keyin V-ing yoki ot bo'lishi shart.
Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi katagiga qaytadi. 'Talk for 20/30 seconds' kataklarida kamida 3 gap aytiladi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

2.title: Dominoes: used to + V1 or be used to + V-ing?
2.stage: 'Kombinatsiya' bosqichida — V1 va V-ing farqini mustahkamlash (12 daqiqa)
2.goal: Gap boshini to'g'ri davom bilan ulash: used to / didn't use to / Did…use to + V1 va be/get used to + V-ing yoki ot; olmosh (his/her/their/its) mosligi.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshidan boshlang: o'ng tomondagi gap boshiga mos davomni boshqa toshning chap tomonidan toping.

Tekshirish: used to dan keyin V1, be/get used to dan keyin V-ing yoki ot. Olmosh egaga mos bo'lsin (people → their way, my dad → his way, my brother → his own, my mum → her time, we → each other); 'yet' faqat inkor gapda.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulang; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; xato bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

2.title: Taboo: technology words
2.goal: Technology mavzusidagi so'z va iboralarni (artificial intelligence, wearable technology, tech-savvy, obsolete, back up…) inglizcha tushuntirib berish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida kartadagi so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Tushuntirishda used to / be used to ishlatish tavsiya etiladi: 'People used to…', 'Teenagers are used to…'.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball. Taqiqlangan so'z yoki o'zbekcha so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

2.title: Find someone who… used to have a phone with buttons
2.stage: Dars o'rtasida harakatli mashq, Reading bosqichidan oldin (10 daqiqa)
2.goal: Did you use to…? va Are you used to…? / Are you getting used to…? savollarini tuzish va texnologiya, odatlar haqida javob berish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
Har qator uchun savolni o'quvchi o'zi tuzadi: 'used to' qatorlari → 'Did you use to…?', 'is used to' qatorlari → 'Are you used to…?'.
Javob mos kelsa ('isn't used to' qatorida — 'No'), sinfdoshning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When? Why?).
Bitta ismni ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozish mumkin; o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijani aytadi (masalan: 'Aziz used to have a Nokia.'); ustoz savollarni kalit bilan tekshiradi.

2.goal: Texnologiya va odatlar haqida 3–4 gapli javob berish; used to (oldin) va be/get used to (hozir) qoliplarini to'g'ri ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi 30–45 soniya javob beradi: kamida 3 gap, kamida bitta 'used to' yoki 'be/get used to' gapi.
Tinglovchi ball beradi: to'g'ri ishlatilgan har bir used to / be used to / get used to +1, Technology lug'atidan har so'z +1.

rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va gapdagi qolipni aytadi: 'used to + V1' yoki 'be/get used to + V-ing/ot'.

Ustoz tekshiradi: tartib va qolip to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball, jamoa keyingi konvertni oladi.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

3.title: Grammar Auction: question tags (isn't he? / do they?)
3.stage: YANGI MAVZU (tag jadvali) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
3.goal: Question tag to'g'ri yoki xato ekanini ajratish: tasdiq gap → inkor tag, inkor gap → tasdiq tag; yordamchi fe'l (be/do/did/will/have/modal) va maxsus holatlar: aren't I, shall we, will you, nobody → tasdiq tag.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz biznes mavzusidagi gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap oxiridagi tag to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi: to'g'ri tagni to'liq aytishi kerak (masalan: 'doesn't she?', 'aren't I?').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Your company made a profit last year, didn't it?
items.why: Past Simple (made) → tagda did: didn't it? (company → it).

items.s: She runs a small business, isn't she?
items.fix: She runs a small business, doesn't she?
items.why: runs — Present Simple, tagda does: doesn't she?

items.s: I am late for the meeting, am not I?
items.fix: I am late for the meeting, aren't I?
items.why: Maxsus holat: I am → aren't I?

items.s: Let's set a target for next month, shall we?
items.why: Let's … → shall we?

items.s: Nobody closed the deal, didn't they?
items.fix: Nobody closed the deal, did they?
items.why: nobody — inkor ma'no, shuning uchun tasdiq tag: did they?

items.s: Aziz can't meet the deadline, can he?
items.why: Inkor gap (can't) → tasdiq tag: can he?

items.s: They will launch the product in May, won't they?
items.why: will → tagda won't: won't they?

items.s: The investors weren't happy, weren't they?
items.fix: The investors weren't happy, were they?
items.why: Inkor gap (weren't) → tasdiq tag: were they?

items.s: There is a warehouse near the airport, isn't there?
items.why: There is → isn't there? (there o'zgarmaydi).

items.s: He went bankrupt last year, didn't go he?
items.fix: He went bankrupt last year, didn't he?
items.why: Tag = yordamchi fe'l + olmosh; asosiy fe'l (go) takrorlanmaydi.

items.s: Send me the financial statement, will you?
items.why: Buyruq gap → will you?

items.s: Madina has raised enough capital, doesn't she?
items.fix: Madina has raised enough capital, hasn't she?
items.why: has raised — Present Perfect, yordamchi has: hasn't she?

3.title: Board Game: Business tags — isn't it? didn't they?
3.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin yoki 4-dars boshida takror sifatida (20 daqiqa)
3.goal: Gapga mos question tag qo'shish, xato taglarni tuzatish va biznes hamda kundalik mavzularda tag bilan og'zaki savol berish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: gapni tag bilan TO'LIQ aytadi (masalan: 'She works in marketing, doesn't she?').
Guruh a'zolari tekshiradi: tasdiq ↔ inkor almashdimi, yordamchi fe'l va olmosh to'g'rimi? Shubha bo'lsa — ustozdan so'raladi.
Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi. Ochiq topshiriqlarda (Talk / Ask) kamida bitta to'g'ri tag bo'lishi shart.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi: oldinga yurish, orqaga qaytish, yana zar tashlash yoki navbat o'tkazish.
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

3.goal: Gapga mos tagni topish: yordamchi fe'l (be/do/does/did/will/can/have/should), ega o'rnidagi olmosh (I/you/we/he/she/it/they) yoki there va tasdiq ↔ inkor almashishi; maxsus holatlar: aren't I, shall we, will you, nobody → did they.

60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball. Agar taxmin to'g'ri tag bilan aytilsa ('It's a supplier, isn't it?') — yana +1 bonus.

3.title: Find someone who… (check it with a question tag)
3.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida — dars o'rtasida harakatli mashq (10 daqiqa)
3.goal: Taxminni question tag bilan tekshirish: tasdiq gap + inkor tag ('You want…, don't you?'), inkor gap yoki never + tasdiq tag ('You aren't…, are you?') va qisqa javob (Yes, I do / No, I'm not).
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Avval 1 daqiqada har qatorga mos kelishi mumkin bo'lgan sinfdoshning ismini TAXMIN qilib qalamda yozadi.
Keyin hamma o'rnidan turib, sinf bo'ylab yuradi va taxminini question tag bilan tekshiradi: 'You want to run a business one day, don't you?'
Inkor qatorlarda (isn't, doesn't, never) tag tasdiq bo'ladi: 'You aren't interested in the stock market, are you?'
Sherik qisqa javob beradi (Yes, I do. / No, I'm not.). Taxmin to'g'ri chiqsa — ism ruchka bilan yoziladi; bitta ism ko'pi bilan 2 marta.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni tag bilan sinfga aytadi: 'Aziz wants to run a business, doesn't he?' — sinf javob beradi.

3.title: Speaking cards: business talk with tags
3.stage: 'Writing / speaking mini-vazifa' bosqichida — 1 daqiqalik og'zaki javob (12 daqiqa)
3.goal: Tag savolga qisqa javob berish (Yes, it is / Actually, it isn't) va biznes mavzusida 3–4 gap bilan fikr bildirish; javob oxirida sherikka o'z tag savolini berish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni tag intonatsiyasi bilan o'qiydi.
Sherigi avval qisqa javob beradi ('Yes, it is.' / 'No, I wouldn't.'), keyin kamida 3 gap bilan fikrini tushuntiradi.
Javob oxirida o'zi ham sherigiga bitta tag savol beradi (masalan: 'You agree with me, don't you?').
Tinglovchi tekshiradi: tag to'g'ri bo'lsa +1, biznes so'zi (revenue, profit, customer loyalty…) ishlatilsa +1.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: You'd like to run your own business one day, wouldn't you? What kind of business?

4.title: Grammar Auction: someone, anything, nobody, everyone
4.stage: YANGI MAVZU (some-/any-/no-/every-) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
4.goal: Noaniq olmoshli gaplarni tekshirish: every-/some-/no- + birlik fe'l (is, has), no- bilan fe'l tasdiq shaklda, ikki inkor bo'lmaydi (don't … anything), savolda any-, taklifda some-.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz fan mavzusidagi gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi: nima o'zgarishini aytishi kerak (masalan: 'are → is', 'nothing → anything').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

4.title: Board Game: someone, somewhere, something
4.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin yoki 5-dars boshida takror sifatida (20 daqiqa)
4.goal: Gapga mos noaniq olmoshni (some-/any-/no-/every- + -one/-body/-thing/-where) tanlash, xatolarni tuzatish va fan mavzusida og'zaki gap tuzish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: bo'sh joyli gapni TO'LIQ o'qiydi (masalan: 'Someone is at the door.').
Guruh a'zolari tekshiradi: savol/inkorda any-, no- bilan fe'l tasdiq, every-/some- bilan birlik fe'l. Shubha bo'lsa — ustozdan so'raladi.
Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi. Ochiq topshiriqlarda (Talk / Ask / Describe) kerakli olmoshlar soni ishlatilishi shart.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi: oldinga yurish, orqaga qaytish, yana zar tashlash yoki navbat o'tkazish.
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

4.title: Dominoes: situation ↔ some-/any-/no-/every-
4.stage: YANGI MAVZU jadvalidan keyin — olmoshlar ma'nosini mustahkamlash (12 daqiqa)
4.goal: Vaziyatga mos noaniq olmoshli gapni topish (nowhere, nothing, nobody, everybody, someone, anywhere, anybody, everywhere…); no- bilan fe'l tasdiq, every- bilan birlik fe'l.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonida vaziyat yoki gap boshi yozilgan — unga mantiqan va grammatik mos keladigan davomni boshqa toshning chap tomonidan toping.
Qaysi olmosh kerakligini ayting: odam (-one/-body), narsa (-thing) yoki joy (-where)? Tasdiq, inkor yoki savol?
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Maslahat: tushuntirishni 'It's something…', 'It's a place where…', 'It's someone who…' bilan boshlang.

Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

4.title: Find someone who… knows something about science
4.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida — dars o'rtasida harakatli mashq (10 daqiqa)
4.goal: Noaniq olmoshli savol tuzish: tasdiqdagi some- savolda any- ga aylanadi (something → anything, someone → anyone, somewhere → anywhere); every- bilan birlik fe'l.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchi qatordagi gapni savolga aylantirib so'raydi. DIQQAT: savolda some- → any-: '…knows something about black holes' → 'Do you know anything about black holes?'
'…did nothing special last weekend' qatorida 'Did you do anything special last weekend?' deb so'raladi — 'No, nothing' degan odamning ismi yoziladi.
Mos odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (What do you know? Where did you go?). Bitta ism ko'pi bilan 2 marta.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni aytib beradi: 'Aziz knows something about black holes.'

5.title: Grammar Auction: must have / should have / can't have + V3
5.stage: Yangi mavzu (savol-javob)dan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
5.goal: Modal + have + V3 (must / might / can't / should / shouldn't / could / needn't have) to'g'ri va xato ishlatilgan gaplarni ajratish va xatoni tuzatish; san'at mavzusidagi gaplar.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: modal + have + V3 to'g'ri ishlatilganmi?

Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'must has' → 'must have', 'should of' → 'should have', 'see' → 'seen').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

5.title: Dominoes: evidence → conclusion (modal + have + V3)
5.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida — formula → gap qolipini mustahkamlash (12 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
5.goal: Vaziyat (dalil) va unga mos modal + have + V3 xulosani ulash — must / might / can't / should / shouldn't / could / needn't have ma'nolarini farqlash.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi vaziyatga qaysi xulosa mos kelishini toping va o'sha toshni ulang.
Ma'noga qarang: dalil kuchli — must have; imkonsiz — can't have; ehtimol — might have; afsus — should have; tanbeh — shouldn't have; ortiqcha ish — needn't have.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

someone must have painted it this morning.

should have told me about it.

he must have been in the art room.
This old manuscript has survived for 500 years —
people must have kept it very carefully.
She has never learnt to paint, so she
can't have painted this masterpiece.

5.title: Taboo: the world of art
5.stage: Art (CORE 20) lug'atidan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (10 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
5.goal: Art (san'at) mavzusidagi so'zlarni (artist, masterpiece, portrait, curator, miniature…) inglizcha ta'riflash va topish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball. Tushuntirgan o'quvchi shu so'z bilan modal + have + V3 gap aytsa yana +1 bonus (masalan: The artist must have used a thin brush).
Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi. Imo-ishora mumkin, o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

5.title: Find someone who… should have studied more
5.stage: Dars o'rtasida harakatli mashq — Reading'dan oldin (10 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
5.goal: Modal + have + V3 bilan savol tuzish va javob berish (should have, shouldn't have, could have, needn't have, must have).
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Do you think you should have studied more for the last test?).
Savolda modal + have + V3 bo'lishi shart; 'should had' yoki 'should of' eshitilsa — savol qaytadan beriladi.
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (Why? What happened?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni sinfga aytib beradi (Aziz thinks he should have…).

5.title: Speaking cards: guesses, regrets and art
5.stage: Writing/speaking mini-vazifa o'rnida (IELTS Speaking Part 1 uslubi, 12 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
5.goal: San'at va o'tmishdagi voqealar haqida taxmin, afsus va tanbeh bildirib 3–4 gapli javob berish (must / might / can't / should / could / needn't have + V3).
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi kamida 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi va kamida 2 ta modal + have + V3 ishlatadi.
Tinglovchi to'g'ri ishlatilgan har bir modal + have + V3 uchun +1 ball beradi; xato bo'lsa (should of, must has, have see) — ball yo'q.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

cards: Think of the last picture you drew. What should you have done differently?
Think of a famous old painting. How long must it have taken to paint? Why do you think so?
Have you ever missed an exhibition, a concert or a match? What should you have done?

5.title: Sentence Race: modal + have + V3
5.stage: Uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror yoki keyingi dars boshida (8 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
5.goal: Modal + have + V3 gaplarda so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish (ega + modal + have + V3 + …).
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi: modal + have + V3 yonma-yon turishi kerak. Keyin qo'lini ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball; jamoa gapning ma'nosini aytsa (taxmin / afsus / tanbeh) yana +1 ball. Keyin keyingi konvertni oladi.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

5.title: Quiz Board: must have, should have, masterpiece
5.stage: 'Xatolar ustida ishlash + takror' bosqichida yoki keyingi dars boshida Kahoot o'rniga (15 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
5.goal: Modal + have + V3 ma'nolari, xatolarni tuzatish, san'at lug'ati va og'zaki gap tuzishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Which modal? 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
'Say it!' bo'limida javob to'liq gap bo'lishi shart. Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi; hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

6.title: Grammar Auction: too, enough, so … that, absolutely
6.stage: Yangi mavzu (savol-javob)dan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
6.goal: Daraja ravishlari (very / too / enough / so … that / such … that / almost / absolutely / completely / quite) to'g'ri va xato ishlatilgan gaplarni ajratish va xatoni tuzatish; sog'liq mavzusidagi gaplar.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: daraja ravishi to'g'ri joyda va to'g'ri ma'noda ishlatilganmi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'enough fit' → 'fit enough', 'very delicious' → 'absolutely delicious', 'so … for' → 'so … that').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: It's too hot to go running at midday.
items.why: too + sifat + to V — haddan tashqari, salbiy natija.

items.s: He isn't enough fit to play in the final.
items.fix: He isn't fit enough to play in the final.
items.why: enough sifatdan KEYIN keladi: fit enough.

items.s: Your recovery was absolutely amazing!
items.why: Kuchli sifat (amazing) bilan absolutely ishlatiladi.

items.s: The soup was very delicious, thank you!
items.fix: The soup was absolutely delicious, thank you!
items.why: delicious — kuchli sifat: very emas, absolutely.

items.s: I was so tired that I fell asleep in the waiting room.
items.why: so + sifat + that + natija.

items.s: The new sports centre is too big — I love it!
items.fix: The new sports centre is very big — I love it!
items.why: Ijobiy ma'noda 'too' emas, 'very' (too — salbiy natija).

items.s: We don't get vitamins enough in winter.
items.fix: We don't get enough vitamins in winter.
items.why: Ot bilan enough OTDAN OLDIN keladi: enough vitamins.

items.s: She was such a good doctor that everyone trusted her.
items.why: such + a + sifat + ot + that + natija.

items.s: My grandfather almost never doesn't eat sugar.
items.fix: My grandfather almost never eats sugar.
items.why: almost never o'zi inkor — ikki inkor bo'lmaydi.

items.s: The injury was so bad for she couldn't walk.
items.fix: The injury was so bad that she couldn't walk.
items.why: so … that — natija 'that' bilan, 'for' emas.

items.s: The hospital car park was completely full.
items.why: full — to'liq holat: completely full.

items.s: The lecture about nutrition was quite interesting.
items.why: quite + oddiy sifat — 'ancha, birmuncha'.

6.title: Board Game: Healthy Enough?
6.stage: Sinf mashqlari o'rniga yoki ulardan keyin, gapirish mashqi sifatida (20 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
6.goal: Daraja ravishlari bilan og'zaki gap tuzish: too … to, sifat + enough, so / such … that, quite / rather, almost, kuchli sifatlar bilan absolutely / completely; sog'liq so'zlari.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: gapni to'ldiradi, tuzatadi yoki daraja ravishi bilan to'liq gap aytadi.
Guruh a'zolari tekshiradi (javob kaliti ustozda). Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, qayta zar tashlash, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: Complete: It's ___ cold to swim today. (very / too)
squares.a: too

squares.t: Put 'enough' in the right place: He is strong.
squares.a: He is strong enough.

squares.t: Correct: The film was very amazing.
squares.a: The film was absolutely amazing.

squares.t: How do you feel today? Use 'quite' or 'rather'.
squares.a: e.g. I'm quite tired. / I'm rather sleepy.

squares.a: I was so tired that I slept for 12 hours.

squares.a: freezing

squares.a: We don't have enough time to cook.

squares.a: I almost never eat fast food.

squares.a: e.g. a fever, a sore throat, a headache

squares.a: e.g. I almost fell during the race.

squares.t: Join with 'such … that': He's a good doctor. Everyone trusts him.
squares.a: He is such a good doctor that everyone trusts him.

squares.t: Correct: The injury was so bad for she cried.
squares.a: The injury was so bad that she cried.

squares.t: Say it with 'not … enough': He's too young to drive.
squares.a: He isn't old enough to drive.

squares.t: Say a sentence with 'completely' (empty / wrong).
squares.a: e.g. The first diagnosis was completely wrong.

squares.t: Explain: 'very hot' or 'too hot' — what's the difference?
squares.a: very hot = strong, but OK; too hot = more than OK, a problem

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: is your lifestyle healthy enough?
squares.a: e.g. My lifestyle is fairly healthy, but I don't sleep enough.

squares.t: Give advice for a sore throat. Use 'enough'.
squares.a: e.g. Drink enough warm water and get enough sleep.

squares.t: Ask your partner a question with 'enough'.
squares.a: e.g. Do you get enough sleep?

6.title: Dominoes: so … that, too … to, enough
6.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida — too / enough / so … that qoliplarini mustahkamlash (12 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
6.goal: Gap boshini daraja ravishiga mos davom bilan ulash: so / such … that + natija, too / enough + to V, enough + ot, almost + fe'l, absolutely / completely / utterly + kuchli sifat.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi gap boshiga qaysi davom mos kelishini toping va o'sha toshni ulang.
Grammatik 'ilgak'ka qarang: so / such → that…; too / sifat + enough → to + fe'l; enough → ot; almost → fe'l; absolutely / completely / utterly → kuchli sifat. Keyin ma'noni tekshiring.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

bandages in the first aid kit.

amazing — I feel like a new person.

empty, so the nurses had a quiet day.
I almost
fainted when the nurse took my blood.

high for a man of his age.

painful, but I can still walk.

that everybody wore sun hats.

exhausted and fell asleep at once.

rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball. Topgan o'quvchi shu so'z bilan daraja ravishli gap aytsa yana +1 bonus (masalan: A fever is quite common in winter).
Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi. Imo-ishora mumkin, o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

6.title: Find someone who… gets enough sleep

Savolda daraja ravishi to'g'ri joyda bo'lishi shart ('enough fit' emas — 'fit enough'); xato bo'lsa savol qaytadan beriladi.
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (Why? How often?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni sinfga aytib beradi (Lola gets enough sleep…).

6.title: Speaking cards: health, habits and lifestyle
6.stage: Writing/speaking mini-vazifa o'rnida (IELTS Speaking Part 1 uslubi, 12 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
6.goal: Sog'liq va turmush tarzi haqida 3–4 gapli javob berish va kamida 2 ta daraja ravishi (too, enough, quite, so … that, absolutely) ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi kamida 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi va kamida 2 ta daraja ravishi ishlatadi (masalan: too tired to…, healthy enough, so … that, absolutely exhausted).
Tinglovchi to'g'ri ishlatilgan har bir daraja ravishi uchun +1 ball beradi; xato bo'lsa (enough tall, very delicious) — ball yo'q.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

6.title: Sentence Race: where do too and enough go?
6.stage: Uyga vazifadan oldin tezkor takror yoki keyingi dars boshida (8 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
6.goal: Daraja ravishlarining gapdagi o'rnini to'g'ri qo'yish: enough sifatdan keyin / otdan oldin, too + sifat + to V, so / such … that, almost + fe'l.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi (enough, too, so, almost qayerda turishiga e'tibor!) va qo'lini ko'taradi.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball; jamoa daraja ravishini boshqasiga almashtirib yangi to'g'ri gap aytsa yana +1 ball. Keyin keyingi konvertni oladi.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: This medicine is too strong for young children.

My grandmother's blood pressure is rather high.

6.title: Quiz Board: too, enough, absolutely + health
6.stage: 'Xatolar ustida ishlash + takror' bosqichida yoki keyingi dars boshida Kahoot o'rniga (15 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
6.goal: Daraja ravishlari (too, enough, so / such … that, absolutely), xatolarni tuzatish, sog'liq lug'ati va og'zaki gap tuzishni o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Health words 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
'Say it!' bo'limida javob to'liq gap bo'lishi shart. Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi; hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

qs.q: It's ___ cold to swim. (very / too)

7.title: Grammar Auction: however, whereas, yet, still
7.stage: Yangi mavzu (savol-javob)dan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
7.goal: Qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchilarini (however, nevertheless, still, on the other hand, in contrast, whereas, while, yet) to'g'ri joy, vergul va ma'no bilan ishlatilganini ajratish va xatoni tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: bog'lovchi to'g'ri tanlanganmi, gap boshidami yoki gap ichidami, vergul o'z joyidami?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikkan puli yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'However' dan keyin vergul qo'yadi yoki 'however' ni 'whereas' ga almashtiradi).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Mass tourism often harms nature. In contrast, ecotourism protects it.
items.why: In contrast — ikki narsa farqi; yangi gap boshida, vergul bilan.

items.s: The flight was delayed. However we arrived on time.
items.fix: The flight was delayed. However, we arrived on time.
items.why: However gap boshida kelganda undan keyin vergul qo'yiladi.

items.s: My sister loves package holidays, whereas I prefer budget travel.
items.why: whereas — bitta gap ichida ikki farqni bog'laydi, oldidan vergul.

items.s: Tashkent looks modern, however Khiva looks ancient.
items.fix: Tashkent looks modern, whereas Khiva looks ancient.
items.why: however ikki gapni vergul bilan ulamaydi; bitta gap ichida — whereas.

items.s: The museum was interesting. Whereas, the guided tour was boring.
items.fix: The museum was interesting, whereas the guided tour was boring.
items.why: whereas yangi gap boshida vergul bilan kelmaydi — ikki qismni bitta gapda bog'laydi.

items.s: The journey was long and tiring. Nevertheless, we enjoyed every minute.
items.why: Nevertheless = shunga qaramay: yangi gap boshida, vergul bilan.

items.s: Our train was cancelled. But however, we found a bus to Bukhara.
items.fix: Our train was cancelled. However, we found a bus to Bukhara.
items.why: but va however birga ishlatilmaydi — bittasi yetarli.

items.s: The hostel was cheap, yet, it was very clean.
items.fix: The hostel was cheap, yet it was very clean.
items.why: yet dan keyin vergul qo'yilmaydi (vergul faqat yet dan oldin).

items.s: Some tourists prefer hotels, while others stay with local families.
items.why: while = whereas: bitta gap ichida farq, oldidan vergul.

items.s: I was very tired after the stopover. In contrast, I went sightseeing.
items.fix: I was very tired after the stopover. Nevertheless, I went sightseeing.
items.why: In contrast — ikki narsa farqi uchun; 'shunga qaramay' ma'nosida nevertheless/still.

items.s: A package holiday is easy to organise. On the other hand, it is less flexible.
items.why: On the other hand — ikkinchi tomon (kamchilik): yangi gap, vergul bilan.

items.s: It rained all day in Samarkand. Still, we visited the Registan.
items.why: Still = baribir, shunga qaramay: yangi gap boshida, vergul bilan.

7.title: Board Game: Travel — two sides of every trip
7.stage: Sinf mashqlari o'rniga yoki ulardan keyin, gapirish mashqi sifatida (20 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
7.goal: Gaplarni however / nevertheless / still / on the other hand / in contrast / whereas / while / yet bilan bog'lash, tinish belgisi xatolarini tuzatish va sayohat haqida og'zaki gapirish.
rules: Har 3–4 o'quvchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni og'zaki bajaradi: gaplarni bog'lovchi bilan birlashtiradi, xatoni tuzatadi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Guruh tekshiradi: However / Nevertheless / Still / On the other hand / In contrast — yangi gap boshida, vergul bilan; whereas / while / yet — bitta gap ichida. Shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi.
Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi. Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.t: Join with 'However': The hotel was old. It was clean.
squares.a: The hotel was old. However, it was clean.

squares.t: Finish: Tashkent is big and busy, whereas Khiva …
squares.a: e.g. …whereas Khiva is small and quiet.

squares.t: Correct: The bus was late. However we arrived on time.
squares.a: The bus was late. However, we arrived on time.

squares.t: Say a connector that means 'however' and starts with N.
squares.a: nevertheless

squares.t: Join with 'whereas': I like the mountains. My brother likes the sea.
squares.a: I like the mountains, whereas my brother likes the sea.

squares.t: Finish: The flight was delayed. Still, …
squares.a: e.g. Still, we arrived in time for dinner.

squares.t: Correct: The park was open. Whereas, the museum was closed.
squares.a: The park was open, whereas the museum was closed.

squares.t: Compare trains and planes with 'while'.
squares.a: e.g. Trains are cheaper, while planes are faster.

squares.t: Join with 'yet': It was cold. We went sightseeing.
squares.a: It was cold, yet we went sightseeing.

squares.t: Correct: The souvenir was expensive, yet, we bought it.
squares.a: The souvenir was expensive, yet we bought it.

squares.t: Say one plus of using a travel agent. Then add 'On the other hand, …'.
squares.a: e.g. It saves time. On the other hand, it costs more.

squares.t: Correct: The trip was short, however it was fun.
squares.a: The trip was short. However, it was fun. / …short, yet it was fun.

squares.t: Talk for 20 seconds: budget travel or a package holiday? Use 2 connectors.
squares.a: e.g. Budget travel is cheap, whereas a package holiday is easy. However, …

squares.t: Correct: But however, the guide was friendly.
squares.a: However, the guide was friendly.

squares.t: Fix the connector: He was tired. In contrast, he kept walking.
squares.a: He was tired. Nevertheless (Still), he kept walking.

squares.t: Compare Samarkand and a modern city with 'In contrast'.
squares.a: e.g. Samarkand has many old landmarks. In contrast, Dubai has modern towers.

squares.t: Finish: Peak season is crowded, whereas the off-season …
squares.a: e.g. …whereas the off-season is quiet and cheap.

squares.t: Join with 'Nevertheless': We had jet lag. We went on the excursion.
squares.a: We had jet lag. Nevertheless, we went on the excursion.

squares.t: Tell your group about a trip that went wrong. Use 'Still' or 'Nevertheless'.
squares.a: e.g. Our bus broke down. Still, we reached Khiva in the evening.

squares.t: Where does 'whereas' go: at the start of a new sentence or inside one sentence?
squares.a: Inside one sentence, after a comma: A, whereas B.

squares.t: Compare tourists and locals in your city with 'while'.
squares.a: e.g. Tourists visit museums, while locals go to the bazaar.

squares.t: Correct: She loves ecotourism, however her friends prefer resorts.
squares.a: She loves ecotourism, whereas her friends… / …ecotourism. However, her friends…

squares.t: Talk for 30 seconds: is mass tourism good for Uzbekistan? Use 2 connectors.
squares.a: e.g. Mass tourism brings money. However, it can damage old cities.

squares.t: Describe your dream destination and one problem with it. Use 'yet'.
squares.a: e.g. Japan is my dream destination, yet it is very expensive.

7.title: Dominoes: travel sentences with a twist
7.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida — bog'lovchi va tinish belgilarini mustahkamlash (12 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
7.goal: Gap boshini (However, / Nevertheless, / Still, / On the other hand, / In contrast, / whereas / while / yet bilan tugaydi) mantiqan va grammatik mos davom bilan ulash.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi gap boshi qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi davomga ulanadi — toping va yoniga qo'ying.
Ulashda ikki narsaga qarang: ma'no (haqiqatan qarama-qarshilik bormi?) va so'z mosligi (it, they, others, locals kimga ishora qiladi?).
Zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak. Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz javoblar varag'i bo'yicha tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: The hotel room was tiny. However,
it had a big window and a comfortable bed.
Our flight was delayed by six hours. Nevertheless,
the passengers stayed calm and patient.
The Registan was full of tourists. Still,
we found a quiet corner for photos.
Some tourists love museums, while
others prefer shopping at the bazaar.
Mass tourism can damage nature. In contrast,
ecotourism helps to protect it.
A package holiday is easy to book. On the other hand,
it gives you less freedom.
My sister always travels light, whereas
I take two huge suitcases.
The souvenirs in the old town were expensive, yet
we bought a few for our friends.
Tourists often get lost in the old city, whereas
locals navigate its streets easily.
Travel insurance seems expensive. However,
it can save you thousands if you get ill abroad.
Peak season in Khiva is very crowded, whereas
the off-season is calm and cheap.
Babur often felt homesick for Fergana. Nevertheless,
he never returned to his homeland.
My parents had terrible jet lag in Tokyo. Still,
they stayed awake until ten at night.
The local language was completely new to me, yet
I learned to order food in a week.
Local guesthouses are simple. On the other hand,
they offer real Uzbek hospitality.

7.title: Taboo: travel and tourism
7.stage: Travel CORE 20 lug'atidan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (10 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
7.goal: Sayohat so'zlarini (souvenir, itinerary, accommodation, jet lag, customs…) inglizcha ta'rif, sinonim va misol bilan tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Bonus: tushuntirishda qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchisi ishlatsa (masalan: 'It is small and cheap. However, it reminds you of a trip.') — ustoz +1 qo'shimcha ball beradi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball. Taqiqlangan so'z yoki o'zbekcha so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

7.title: Find someone who… loves travelling, yet hates packing
7.stage: Dars o'rtasida harakatli mashq — Reading'dan oldin (12 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
7.goal: Sayohat haqida savol tuzish va javobni qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchisi bilan berish (However, … / …, whereas … / …, yet …).
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Do you prefer the mountains or the sea? What about your family?).
Javob beruvchi bog'lovchi bilan to'liq gap aytadi: 'Yes. The trip was long. However, it was fun.' yoki 'I prefer the mountains, whereas my family prefers the sea.'
Qatorga mos kelgan odamning ismini yozadi. Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 3 ta natijani whereas / while / however bilan sinfga aytadi (Aziz prefers trains, whereas Lola prefers planes).

items.t: …has been on a long journey that was tiring, yet fun.
items.q: Have you ever been on a long journey that was tiring, yet fun?

items.t: …prefers the mountains, whereas his/her family prefers the sea.
items.q: Do you prefer the mountains or the sea? What about your family?

items.q: Have you been to Samarkand many times? Have you ever been to Khiva?

items.t: …always travels light, whereas his/her mother packs a lot.
items.q: Do you always travel light? Does your mother pack a lot?

items.t: …has bought a souvenir that was cheap, yet beautiful.
items.q: Have you ever bought a souvenir that was cheap, yet beautiful?

items.t: …is afraid of flying. Still, he/she travels by plane.
items.q: Are you afraid of flying? Do you still travel by plane?

items.t: …enjoys sightseeing, while his/her friends prefer shopping.
items.q: Do you enjoy sightseeing? Do your friends prefer shopping?

items.t: …felt homesick on a trip. Nevertheless, he/she stayed until the end.
items.q: Have you ever felt homesick on a trip? Did you stay until the end?

items.t: …thinks international travel is exciting, yet expensive.
items.q: Do you think international travel is exciting, yet expensive?

items.t: …once had a delayed flight or train, yet arrived on time.
items.q: Has your flight or train ever been delayed? Did you still arrive on time?

items.q: Do you like guided tours? Does your best friend prefer exploring alone?

items.q: Do you want to visit Japan? Do you think it is too expensive?

7.goal: Sayohat mavzusida 30–60 soniyalik javob berish va kamida 2 xil qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchisini to'g'ri ishlatish.

8.title: Grammar Auction: home, abroad, anywhere, nearby
8.stage: Yangi mavzu (savol-javob)dan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
8.goal: O'rin ravishlari (home, abroad, upstairs, everywhere, somewhere, anywhere, nowhere, nearby, there) to'g'ri tanlangan, predlogsiz va to'g'ri joyda ishlatilganini ajratish va xatoni tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: ravish to'g'ri tanlanganmi (anywhere/nowhere), ortiqcha predlog bormi (to home, in abroad), ravish o'z joyidami?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikkan puli yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'lived in abroad' → 'lived abroad').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

8.title: Board Game: here, there, everywhere in history
8.stage: Sinf mashqlari o'rniga yoki ulardan keyin, gapirish mashqi sifatida (20 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
8.goal: O'rin ravishlarini (here/there, everywhere/somewhere/anywhere/nowhere, nearby, abroad, upstairs, indoors…) tanlash, xatoni tuzatish, so'z tartibi va tarixiy joylar haqida gapirish.
rules: Har 3–4 o'quvchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni og'zaki bajaradi: qarama-qarshi so'zni aytadi, xatoni tuzatadi, gap tuzadi yoki 20–30 soniya gapiradi.
Guruh tekshiradi: home / abroad / upstairs / indoors — predlogsiz; inkor va savolda — anywhere; ravish fe'ldan (yoki ob'ektdan) keyin, vaqtdan oldin. Shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi.
Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi. Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

8.title: Dominoes: place adverbs and their meanings
8.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida — ravishlar ma'nosi va qoidalarini mustahkamlash (12 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
8.goal: O'rin ravishini (here, there, somewhere, anywhere, nowhere, nearby, abroad, upstairs, indoors, home…) uning inglizcha ta'rifi va ishlatilish qoidasi bilan ulash.
rules: Har juftlik yoki guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi ravishga (masalan: abroad) mos inglizcha ta'rifni boshqa toshning chap tomonidan toping va ulang.
Ta'riflardagi qoidalarga e'tibor bering: 'used in questions and negatives' — anywhere, 'the verb stays positive' — nowhere, 'no preposition' — abroad va home.
Zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak. Birinchi tugatgan guruh 5 ta ravish bilan tarixga oid gap aytadi (masalan: The ruins are nearby. He lived abroad.).
Ustoz javoblar varag'i bo'yicha tekshiradi. To'g'ri tugatgan va gaplari to'g'ri bo'lgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

8.title: Taboo: history words
8.stage: History CORE 20 lug'atidan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (10 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
8.goal: Tarix so'zlarini (empire, dynasty, fortress, ruins, treaty, archaeologist…) inglizcha ta'rif, sinonim va misol bilan tushuntirish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Bonus: tushuntirishda o'rin ravishi ishlatsa (masalan: 'You can see them everywhere in Khiva.') — ustoz +1 qo'shimcha ball beradi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball. Taqiqlangan so'z yoki o'zbekcha so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

8.title: Find someone who… has been abroad
8.stage: Dars o'rtasida harakatli mashq — Reading'dan oldin (12 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
8.goal: O'rin ravishlari bilan savol tuzish: tasdiqdagi somewhere savolda anywhere ga aylanadi; home / abroad / upstairs — predlogsiz.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi. Diqqat: '…went somewhere' → 'Did you go anywhere…?'; 'went home' → 'Did you go home…?' (to home emas).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (Where exactly? When did you go there?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 3 ta natijani sinfga aytadi (Dilnoza has been abroad. She went to Turkey.).

8.stage: 'Writing / speaking mini-vazifa' o'rniga — 1 daqiqalik og'zaki javob (IELTS Speaking Part 1 uslubi, 12 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlang
8.goal: Tarixiy joylar va sayohat haqida 30–60 soniya gapirish, kamida 2 ta o'rin ravishini (there, nearby, abroad, everywhere, somewhere, anywhere…) to'g'ri ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi 30–60 soniya javob beradi va kamida 2 xil o'rin ravishi ishlatadi (there, nearby, abroad, everywhere, somewhere, upstairs…).
Tinglovchi ravishlarni sanaydi: to'g'ri ishlatilgan har bir yangi ravish +1 ball; 'go to home', 'in abroad' kabi xato uchun −1 ball.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib; ustoz 2–3 eng yaxshi javobni sinfga qayta aytdiradi.

9.title: Grammar Auction: like, as, as if, instead of
9.stage: YANGI MAVZU (like / as / as if …) tushuntirilgandan keyin, Kombinatsiyadan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
9.goal: LIKE (o'xshatish) va AS (haqiqiy vazifa), AS IF / AS THOUGH + Past Simple (noreal), SUCH AS, THE SAME AS, JUST AS, UNLIKE, INSTEAD OF + V-ing to'g'ri yoki xato ishlatilganini ajratish va xatoni tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: like / as / as if / such as / the same as / instead of to'g'ri ishlatilganmi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi, lekin qoidani aytishi shart: 'o'xshatish → like', 'haqiqiy kasb → as', 'noreal → as if + Past Simple', 'instead of + V-ing'.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

9.title: Dominoes: like, as, as if, such as, unlike
9.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida: formula → gap bog'lanishini mustahkamlash (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
9.goal: Gap boshini (like / as / as if / as though / such as / the same / unlike / instead of / just as) grammatik va mantiqan to'g'ri davom bilan ulash; genetika mavzusidagi gaplarni tushunish.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshini aralashtirib bering.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi gap boshi (masalan, 'My grandmother worked as') qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi davom bilan to'liq gap bo'lishini toping.
Tanlashda ham grammatikaga (as if + to'liq gap, instead of + V-ing, the same + as), ham ma'noga qarang: har gap boshiga faqat bitta davom mos keladi.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi va 2 ta gapni o'zbekchaga tarjima qiladi; ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

10.title: Grammar Auction: mixed conditionals
10.stage: YANGI MAVZU (Mixed 1 / Mixed 2) tushuntirilgandan keyin, Kombinatsiyadan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
10.goal: Aralash shart gaplarni (Mixed 1: If + Past Perfect, would + V1 … now; Mixed 2: If + Past Simple, would have + V3 … yesterday) to'g'ri yoki xato ishlatilganini ajratish va xatoni tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: shart qaysi vaqtda (o'tgan / hozir), natija qaysi vaqtda (now / yesterday)?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi, lekin sababini aytishi shart: 'now → would + V1', 'yesterday → would have + V3', 'if-qismida would yo'q'.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: If I had learned to code at school, I would work in IT now.
items.why: O'tgan shart (had learned) → hozirgi natija (now): would + V1.

items.s: If I had bought a VR headset last year, I would have been an expert now.
items.fix: If I had bought a VR headset last year, I would be an expert now.
items.why: 'now' — hozirgi natija: would + V1 (would have been emas).

items.s: If he were more careful, he wouldn't have broken the controller yesterday.
items.why: Doimiy xarakter (hozir) → o'tgan natija (yesterday): would have + V3.

items.s: If she would be braver, she would have tried the VR roller coaster.
items.fix: If she were braver, she would have tried the VR roller coaster.
items.why: If-qismida would ishlatilmaydi: If she were braver…

items.s: If I studied IT at university five years ago, I would be a programmer now.
items.fix: If I had studied IT at university five years ago, I would be a programmer now.
items.why: O'tgan shart (five years ago) → Past Perfect: had studied.

items.s: If the graphics weren't so realistic, I wouldn't have felt sick yesterday.
items.why: Hozirgi holat (grafika realistik) → o'tgan natija: wouldn't have felt.

items.s: If I had a car, I would have drove you to the VR centre yesterday.
items.fix: If I had a car, I would have driven you to the VR centre yesterday.
items.why: would have + V3: drive → drove → driven.

items.s: If Zuckerberg hadn't left Harvard, would he be a billionaire today?
items.why: Mixed 1 savol: hadn't left (o'tgan) → would he be … today?

items.s: If she was more patient, she wouldn't make that mistake yesterday.
items.fix: If she was more patient, she wouldn't have made that mistake yesterday.
items.why: O'tgan natija (yesterday) → would have + V3.

items.s: If I had a VR headset, I would play games every day.
items.why: Takror Type 2 (hozirgi noreal): Past Simple + would + V1.

items.s: If we hadn't updated the software, the game wouldn't work now.
items.why: O'tgan shart (hadn't updated) → hozirgi natija (now): wouldn't + V1.

items.s: If I would have saved money last year, I would own a headset now.
items.fix: If I had saved money last year, I would own a headset now.
items.why: If-qismida would have emas, Past Perfect: had saved.

10.title: Board Game: If I had…, I would… now
10.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin yoki ularning bir qismi o'rniga (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
10.goal: Mixed 1 va Mixed 2 shart gaplarni og'zaki tuzish, turini aniqlash (Type 2 / Type 3 / Mixed), xatoni tuzatish va VR so'zlarini ishlatish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: fe'lni to'g'ri shaklga qo'yadi, turini aytadi, xatoni tuzatadi yoki to'liq gap aytadi.
Guruhdan bir o'quvchi 'hakam' bo'ladi va javoblar varag'iga qarab tekshiradi; 'e.g.' bilan berilgan ochiq topshiriqlarda istalgan to'g'ri gap qabul qilinadi.
Javob xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi. Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.a: driven / bought / made

Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

10.title: Sentence Race: mixed conditionals

10.goal: Aralash shart gaplarda so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish: if-qism (Past Perfect / Past Simple) + vergul + natija (would + V1 / would have + V3).
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning aralashtirilgan so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi. Yordam: 'If' — gap boshi, vergulli so'z — if-qism oxiri, nuqta yoki '?' bor so'z — gap oxiri.
Tayyor bo'lgach qo'l ko'taradi va gapni o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball va keyingi konvert.
Qo'shimcha +1: jamoa gap Mixed 1 yoki Mixed 2 ekanini va nima uchun ekanini (now / yesterday) aytsa.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

11.title: Grammar Auction: each / every / either / neither
11.stage: Yangi mavzu (each / every / either / neither) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi.
11.goal: each / every / either / neither + birlik ot + birlik fe'l va each of / neither of + ko'plik ot + birlik fe'l qoidasini, 'every of' yo'qligini, neither bilan fe'l tasdiqligini, 2 ta narsa uchun each (every emas) ekanini tekshirish.
rules: Sinfni 3–4 jamoaga bo'ling. Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: each / every / either / neither to'g'ri ishlatilganmi, ot va fe'l birlikmi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'Every of the spectators' → 'Each of the spectators', 'Neither team didn't score' → 'Neither team scored').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p qolgan jamoa).

items.s: Each player in our team has a different number.
items.why: each + birlik ot (player) + birlik fe'l (has).

items.why: either + birlik ot + birlik fe'l: ikkitadan istalgani.

items.fix: Each of the spectators stood up.
items.why: 'every of' bo'lmaydi: each of + ko'plik ot yoki every + birlik ot.

items.why: Gap oxiridagi each — 'har biri' (har bir chipta).

items.s: Neither assistant referees saw the foul.
items.fix: Neither assistant referee saw the foul.
items.why: neither + birlik ot: assistant referee (ko'plik emas).

items.why: not … either = neither: ikkala jamoani ham yoqtirmayman.

11.title: Board Game: every day, each player, neither team
11.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin, gapirish mashqi sifatida (20 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi.
11.goal: each / every / either / neither bilan og'zaki gap tuzish, xatoni tuzatish va sport haqida qisqa gapirish (every day, each team, either court, neither team).
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: bo'sh joyni to'ldiradi, xatoni tuzatadi yoki to'liq gap aytadi.
Guruh a'zolari javob kalitiga qarab tekshiradi; shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'Talk for 20/30 seconds' kataklarida o'yinchi kamida bitta each / every / either / neither ishlatishi shart, aks holda javob sanalmaydi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

11.title: Dominoes: sport Q&A with each / every / either / neither
11.stage: Grammatika jadvali tugagach, Sport lug'atidan oldin (12 daqiqa). Tanlanmasa — keyingi darsda takror uchun.
11.goal: Sport haqidagi savolga mos javobni topish: 2 ta narsa uchun either / neither, ko'p narsa uchun each / every, 'every four years' va '… each' (har biri) ma'nolarini farqlash.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi SAVOLga javob bo'ladigan toshni toping — javob toshning chap tomonida yozilgan.
Javob tanlashda sonni tekshiring: savolda 2 ta narsa bo'lsa — either / neither, ko'p narsa bo'lsa — each / every javobi mos keladi.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh savol-javoblarni ikki kishi bo'lib ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: How often are the Olympic Games held?
Every four years.

50,000 som each.

Either court is free right now.

Neither team scored. It was 0–0.

Yes, each of them got a gold medal.

Every Monday and Thursday evening.

Yes, each match is broadcast live.

11.title: Taboo: sport words
11.stage: Sport CORE 20 lug'atidan keyin, kombinatsiyadan oldin (10 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi.
11.goal: Sport lug'atini (referee, spectator, underdog, trophy, substitute va b.) inglizcha tushuntirib berish; imkon bo'lsa each / every / either / neither bilan gap tuzish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Tushuntirishda dars grammatikasi bilan gap aytsa +1 bonus (masalan: 'Every match needs one. He or she shows yellow and red cards.' → referee).
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

11.title: Find someone who… does sport every day
11.stage: Dars o'rtasida, Reading oldidan harakatli mashq (10 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi.
11.goal: every / each / either bilan savol tuzish va javob berish (Do you … every day? Does either of your parents …?), sport odatlari haqida gapirish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Do you go to a sports club every week?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (When? Which sport?).
'Neither' qatorida savol 'Does either of your parents play football?' bo'ladi; javob 'No, neither of them does' bo'lsa — ism yoziladi.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni sinfga aytib beradi (masalan: 'Aziz does sport every day.').

12.title: Grammar Auction: any / both / all / none
12.stage: Yangi mavzu (any / both / all / none) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi.
