Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p qolgan jamoa).

items.s: Both charities help homeless people in our city.
items.why: both + ko'plik ot (charities) + ko'plik fe'l (help).

items.s: Both volunteer are students from our university.
items.fix: Both volunteers are students from our university.
items.why: both + ko'plik ot: volunteers.

items.s: All children have the right to education.
items.why: all + ko'plik ot + ko'plik fe'l (have).

items.s: All the information in this report are useful.
items.fix: All the information in this report is useful.
items.why: information — sanalmas ot: all + sanalmas ot + birlik fe'l (is).

items.s: Any student can join our volunteer club.
items.why: any + birlik ot — 'istalgan talaba' (3 va undan ko'p ichidan).

items.s: I have three cousins, and both of them work as teachers.
items.fix: I have three cousins, and all of them work as teachers.
items.why: 3 kishi → all; both faqat 2 ta uchun.

items.s: None of the families in this village has a car.
items.why: none of + ko'plik ot + birlik fe'l (rasmiy uslub).

items.s: I asked my two brothers, but none of them knew the answer.
items.fix: I asked my two brothers, but neither of them knew the answer.
items.why: 2 kishi → neither; none — 3 va undan ko'p uchun.

items.s: None of the volunteers didn't come on Sunday.
items.fix: None of the volunteers came on Sunday.
items.why: none o'zi inkor ma'no beradi — fe'l tasdiq bo'ladi (ikki inkor yo'q).

items.s: Both poverty and unemployment are serious problems.
items.why: both … and … + ko'plik fe'l (are).

items.s: All of students in our group gave money to charity.
items.fix: All of the students in our group gave money to charity.
items.why: all of + the / our / olmosh + ot; 'all of students' bo'lmaydi.

items.s: All of us want to live in a fair society.
items.why: all of + olmosh (us) + ko'plik fe'l (want).

12.title: Board Game: both, all, any, none
12.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin, gapirish mashqi sifatida (20 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi.
12.goal: any / both / all / none bilan og'zaki gap tuzish, 2 va 3+ farqini tanlash (both — all, either — any, neither — none) va ijtimoiy muammolar haqida qisqa fikr aytish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: so'zni tanlaydi, xatoni tuzatadi yoki to'liq gap aytadi.
'Both or all?', 'Neither or none?' kataklarida o'yinchi javob bilan birga sababini aytadi: '2 ta' yoki '3 va undan ko'p'.
Guruh a'zolari javob kalitiga qarab tekshiradi; shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

12.title: Dominoes: Q&A with any / both / all / none
12.stage: Kombinatsiyadan keyin, sinf mashqlari boshida — grammatika va lug'at o'tilgach (12 daqiqa). Tanlanmasa — keyingi darsda takror uchun.
12.goal: Savolga mos javobni topish: both (2) — all (3+), neither (2) — none (3+), either (2) — any (3+); all + sanalmas ot (all of it); ijtimoiy mavzu so'zlari.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi SAVOLga javob bo'ladigan toshni toping — javob toshning chap tomonida yozilgan.
Javob tanlashda sonni tekshiring: savolda 2 kishi / narsa bo'lsa — both / either / neither, ko'p bo'lsa — all / any / none javobi mos keladi.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh savol-javoblarni ikki kishi bo'lib ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

pairs: Do both of your parents work?
Yes, both of them are nurses.
Which of these charities can I give money to?
Any charity on this list is fine.
Did any of the students know the word 'illiteracy'?
No, none of them knew it.
What are the two biggest problems in the city?
Both unemployment and homelessness.
Is all the information in this report true?
Yes, all of it is correct.
Who can join the volunteer club?
Any student can join it.
Were your two grandfathers teachers?
No, neither of them was. Both were farmers.
How many of your classmates have a phone?
All of them have one.
How much of the money did you donate?
All of it went to a children's charity.
Did anyone in the village go hungry last winter?
No, none of the families went hungry.
Is it true that all girls are bad at maths?
No, that's just a stereotype.
Which of the two volunteers should I call?
Either of them. Both know the address.
Do all people in the world have clean water?
No, not all of them. Millions don't.

12.title: Taboo: social issues
12.stage: Social issues CORE 20 lug'atidan keyin, kombinatsiyadan oldin (10 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi.
12.goal: Ijtimoiy muammolar lug'atini (poverty, unemployment, homelessness, stereotype, volunteer va b.) inglizcha tushuntirish; imkon bo'lsa all / both / any / none bilan gap tuzish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Tushuntirishda dars grammatikasi bilan gap aytsa +1 bonus (masalan: 'All of these people work, but none of them get money.' → volunteer).
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

12.title: Find someone who… (both / all / any / none)
12.stage: Dars o'rtasida, Reading oldidan harakatli mashq (10 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi.
12.goal: both / all / any bilan savol tuzish va javob berish (Do both of your …? Do you think all …? Do any of your friends …?), jamiyat mavzusida fikr almashish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Do both of your parents work?).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (Why? What do they do?).
'none' qatorida savol 'Do any of your friends read newspapers?' bo'ladi; javob 'No, none of them do' bo'lsa — ism yoziladi.
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni sinfga aytib beradi (masalan: 'Both of Madina's parents work.').

12.title: Speaking cards: social issues with all / both / any / none
12.stage: Writing / speaking mini-vazifa o'rnida, IELTS Speaking Part 3 uslubida (12 daqiqa). Tanlanmasa — keyingi darsning warm-up'i.
12.goal: Ijtimoiy muammolar mavzusida 3–4 gapli javob berish va javobda all / both / any / none ni kamida bir marta ishlatish.
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi kamida 3 gap bilan javob beradi va kamida 1 marta all / both / any / none ishlatadi.
Tinglovchi shu so'zlarni sanaydi: to'g'ri ishlatilgan har biri +1 ball; xato bo'lsa (masalan 'Both player is …') ball berilmaydi va tuzatiladi.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

12.title: Sentence Race: any, both, all, none
12.stage: Xatolar ustida ishlash bosqichida tezkor takror (8 daqiqa). Tanlanmasa — uyga vazifadan oldin 5 daqiqalik takror.
12.goal: any / both / all / none li gaplarda so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish (Both of my …, All of us …, None of …, Any student …).
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va qo'lini ko'taradi. Katta harf bilan boshlangan so'z — gap boshi, nuqta yoki so'roq belgili so'z — gap oxiri.
Ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa jamoa +1 ball va keyingi konvertni oladi; jamoa gapni o'zbekchaga tarjima qilsa yana +1.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

12.title: Quiz Board: 2 or 3+? + social issues
12.stage: Dars oxiridagi umumiy takror yoki keyingi dars boshida Kahoot o'rniga (15 daqiqa). Darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlanadi.
12.goal: any / both / all / none grammatikasi (2 va 3+ farqi, fe'l mosligi) va Social issues lug'atini o'yin shaklida takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: '2 or 3+? 300').
Ustoz savolni o'qiydi; jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. 'Say it!' bo'limida javob to'liq gap bo'lishi shart.
To'g'ri — ball jamoaga. Xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
Ishlatilgan katak doskada o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

13.title: Grammar Auction: is or are? (subject–verb agreement)
13.stage: Yangi mavzu (ega–kesim mosligi) va Kombinatsiyadan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
13.goal: Ega–kesim mosligini tekshirish: the number of / a number of, one of the, some / all of, either…or / neither…nor, gerund ega va sanalmas otlar (information, advice) bilan is/are, has/have, -s ni to'g'ri tanlash va xatoni tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: ega bilan fe'l mosmi (is/are, has/have, fe'l + -s)?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan va qoidani aytgan jamoa (masalan: 'one of → birlik fe'l') +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: The number of young people who read self-help books is growing.
items.why: the number of + ko'plik ot → birlik fe'l: is (son bitta).

items.s: A number of my classmates has joined a public speaking club.
items.fix: A number of my classmates have joined a public speaking club.
items.why: a number of (= many) → ko'plik fe'l: have.

items.s: One of the most useful habits is getting up early.
items.why: one of the + ko'plik ot → birlik fe'l: is.

items.s: Setting clear goals help you stay motivated.
items.fix: Setting clear goals helps you stay motivated.
items.why: Gerund ega (Setting clear goals) → birlik fe'l: helps.

items.s: Neither my parents nor my sister know about my new routine.
items.fix: Neither my parents nor my sister knows about my new routine.
items.why: neither…nor: fe'l yaqin egaga mos — my sister (birlik) → knows.

items.s: Either my coach or my teammates are going to give me feedback.
items.why: either…or: yaqin ega — my teammates (ko'plik) → are.

items.s: The information on this website were very helpful.
items.fix: The information on this website was very helpful.
items.why: information — sanalmas ot → birlik fe'l: was.

items.s: Some of my bad habits are hard to break.
items.why: some of + ko'plik ot → ko'plik fe'l: are.

items.s: One of my friends keep a daily journal.
items.fix: One of my friends keeps a daily journal.
items.why: one of + ko'plik ot → birlik fe'l: keeps.

items.s: The number of mistakes in my essays are getting smaller.
items.fix: The number of mistakes in my essays is getting smaller.
items.why: the number of → birlik fe'l: is (mistakes emas, 'number' ega).

items.s: There is a lot of useful advice in this book.
items.why: advice — sanalmas ot → there is (birlik).

items.s: Reading ten pages every day builds a strong habit.
items.why: Gerund ega (Reading ten pages) → birlik fe'l: builds.

13.title: Board Game: One of my habits is…
13.stage: Sinf mashqlari bosqichida, 'Fe'l shaklini tanlang' mashqidan keyin (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
13.goal: Ega–kesim mosligini og'zaki mashq qilish (is/are, has/have, -s) va shaxsiy rivojlanish so'zlari (habit, routine, procrastination, goal) bilan gap tuzish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.

Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: 'Choose' — to'g'ri fe'lni tanlab, butun gapni o'qiydi; 'Correct' — gapni to'g'rilaydi; 'Talk' — aytilgan vaqt davomida gapiradi.
Guruh a'zolari javobni tekshiradi; shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi (ustozda javoblar varag'i bor). Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Javobda qoidani ham aytgan o'yinchi (masalan: 'neither…nor — yaqin ega') yana 1 katak oldinga yuradi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

13.title: Dominoes: subject + the right verb
13.stage: Sinf mashqlari bosqichida, 'Gapni to'ldiring' mashqi o'rniga yoki undan keyin (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
13.goal: Gap boshini (ega) mos davomi (kesim) bilan ulash: birlik ega → is/has/was/-s, ko'plik ega → are/have/were; either…or / neither…nor da yaqin ega; ma'no ham mos bo'lishi kerak.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi ega (gap boshi) qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi davomga mos kelishini toping.
Ulashda ikki narsani tekshiring: 1) fe'l shakli egaga mosmi (is/are, has/have, -s)? 2) gap ma'noli chiqyaptimi?

14.title: Grammar Auction: Walking… / Shocked by…
14.stage: -ing / -ed clauses tushuntirilib, Kombinatsiyadan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
14.goal: -ing clause (ega o'zi bajaradi) va -ed clause (egaga nisbatan bajarilgan, passiv) ni ajratish; otdan keyingi -ing / V3, gerund ega + birlik fe'l va 'ega bir xil bo'lsin' qoidasini tekshirish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: -ing yoki -ed to'g'ri tanlanganmi? Ikkala qismning egasi bir xilmi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikkan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan va sababini aytgan jamoa (masalan: 'passiv → Shocked') +50 oladi.
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Feeling tired after the coding class, I went straight to bed.
items.why: Ega (I) o'zi charchagan → -ing clause (sabab): Feeling.

items.s: Shocking by the deepfake video, my grandmother called me.
items.fix: Shocked by the deepfake video, my grandmother called me.
items.why: Video buvini hayratga solgan (passiv) → V3: Shocked by.

items.s: Trained on millions of photos, the app can recognise faces.
items.why: App o'rgatilgan (passiv) → V3: Trained; ega — the app.

items.s: Using a chatbot, the essay was finished in ten minutes.
items.fix: Using a chatbot, I finished the essay in ten minutes.
items.why: Insho chatbotdan foydalanmaydi — ikkala qism egasi bir xil bo'lsin (I).

items.s: The robot cleaning our office was made in Korea.
items.why: Robot o'zi tozalaydi (faol) → otdan keyin V-ing: cleaning.

items.s: The data collecting by smartwatches is very personal.
items.fix: The data collected by smartwatches is very personal.
items.why: Ma'lumot to'planadi (passiv) → otdan keyin V3: collected.

items.s: Writing a clear prompt is the key to a good answer.
items.why: Gerund ega (Writing a clear prompt) → birlik fe'l: is.

items.s: Using AI tools every day save me a lot of time.
items.fix: Using AI tools every day saves me a lot of time.
items.why: Gerund ega (Using AI tools…) → birlik fe'l: saves.

items.s: Not knowing the answer, the chatbot invented one.
items.why: Chatbot o'zi bilmaydi (faol, sabab) → Not knowing; ega — the chatbot.

items.s: The man stood next to the robot is the developer.
items.fix: The man standing next to the robot is the developer.
items.why: Odam o'zi turibdi (faol, hozir) → otdan keyin V-ing: standing.

items.s: Interesting in robotics, my cousin wants to study engineering.

items.why: Qiziqish egada (u qiziqadi) → -ed: Interested in.

items.why: Tizim yaratilgan (passiv) → V3: Designed; ega — this AI system.

14.title: Board Game: -ing or -ed clause?
14.stage: Sinf mashqlari bosqichida, '-ing yoki -ed' mashqidan keyin (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
14.goal: -ing / -ed clause ni og'zaki tanlash, ikki gapni bitta gapga birlashtirish, xato egani tuzatish va AI so'zlari bilan gap tuzish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.

Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: 'Choose' — to'g'ri shaklni tanlab butun gapni o'qiydi; 'Join' — ikki gapni -ing yoki -ed bilan bitta gapga aylantiradi; 'Correct' — xatoni tuzatadi.
Guruh a'zolari javobni tekshiradi; shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi (ustozda javoblar varag'i bor). Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'Talk' kataklarida o'yinchi aytilgan vaqt gapiradi va kamida 1 ta -ing yoki -ed clause ishlatadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

14.title: Dominoes: -ing / -ed clause + main clause
14.stage: Sinf mashqlarida, 'Ikki gapni birlashtiring' mashqi o'rniga yoki undan keyin (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.

Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz javoblar varag'i bo'yicha tekshiradi.
Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

14.title: Sentence Race: participle clauses

14.goal: -ing / -ed clause li gaplarda so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish: vergulli so'z — clause oxiri, undan keyin asosiy gapning egasi keladi; otdan keyingi -ing / V3 va gerund ega ham bor.
rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning kesilgan so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi: katta harfli so'z — gap boshi (I va ismlar — Aziz, Japan — bundan mustasno), vergulli so'z — clause oxiri, nuqtali so'z — gap oxiri.
Tayyor bo'lgach jamoa qo'lini ko'taradi; ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball va keyingi konvert.
Bonus +1: jamoa gapdagi -ing yoki -ed ni tushuntirsa (kim bajaradi / kimga bajariladi).
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

15.title: Grammar Auction: who / which / that
15.stage: YANGI MAVZU (who / which / that) tushuntirilgandan keyin, Kombinatsiyadan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
15.goal: who (odam) / which, that (narsa) to'g'ri tanlanganini, ortiqcha 'it/he' va tushib qolgan ega 'who' ni, vergulli gapda 'that' xatosini topish va tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.

Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: odamga who, narsaga which/that ishlatilganmi? Ortiqcha 'it/he' yoki tushib qolgan 'who' yo'qmi? Verguldan keyin that emasmi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'The man which sold…' → 'The man who sold…').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa.

items.s: A miner is a person who checks transactions.
items.why: Odam + ega vazifasida → who + fe'l (who checks).

items.s: The app who I use for trading is free.
items.fix: The app which I use for trading is free.
items.why: app — narsa → which/that; who faqat odam uchun.

items.s: The coin which I bought it last week has doubled.
items.fix: The coin which I bought last week has doubled.
items.why: which o'zi to'ldiruvchi — 'it' ortiqcha (ikki marta to'ldiruvchi).

items.s: Bitcoin, that appeared in 2009, was the first cryptocurrency.
items.fix: Bitcoin, which appeared in 2009, was the first cryptocurrency.
items.why: Vergulli (non-defining) gapda that ishlatilmaydi → which.

items.s: A digital wallet is an app that stores your private keys.
items.why: Narsa + ega → that/which + fe'l (that stores).

items.s: The man which sold me the token was a scammer.
items.fix: The man who sold me the token was a scammer.
items.why: man — odam → who (which faqat narsa uchun).

items.s: The exchange which I trade on is safe.
items.why: Predlog oxirida qoladi: I trade ON the exchange → which I trade on.

items.s: The trader lost all his money now sells phones.
items.fix: The trader who lost all his money now sells phones.
items.why: Ega vazifasidagi who tushirib qoldirilmaydi (who + fe'l).

items.s: Satoshi Nakamoto, who invented Bitcoin, is still unknown.
items.why: Odam + vergul (qo'shimcha ma'lumot) → who; that bo'lmaydi.

items.fix: My cousin, who is a miner, lives in Nukus.
items.why: who o'zi ega — 'he' ortiqcha.

15.title: Board Game: people who…, coins which…
15.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin yoki ularning bir qismi o'rniga, Reading'dan oldin (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
15.goal: who / which / that bilan ikki gapni birlashtirish, xatoni tuzatish, 'tushirsa bo'ladimi?' savoli va kripto so'zlariga relative clause bilan ta'rif berish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni og'zaki bajaradi: to'liq gap aytadi (who / which / that bilan).
Guruh a'zolari javob kalitidan tekshiradi (kalitni bitta 'hakam' o'quvchi ushlab turadi). Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
'Join' kataklarida ikki gap bitta gapga aylantiriladi; 'it/he' qoldirilsa — javob xato hisoblanadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

squares.a: who (that is also possible)

squares.a: This is the wallet (which/that) I use every day.

squares.t: Can you omit 'who'? The girl who called you is my cousin.
squares.a: No — 'who' is the subject here (who + verb).

squares.t: Define 'digital wallet' with 'an app which…'.
squares.a: e.g. A digital wallet is an app which stores your keys.

squares.t: Correct: The coin which I bought it has doubled.
squares.a: The coin which I bought has doubled.

squares.t: Finish the sentence: 'A person who I admire is…'
squares.a: e.g. A person who I admire is my father, because he works hard.

squares.t: Can you omit 'which'? The phone which she bought is new.
squares.a: Yes: The phone she bought is new. ('which' is the object)

squares.t: Join with commas: Bitcoin has no bank. It appeared in 2009.
squares.a: Bitcoin, which appeared in 2009, has no bank.

squares.t: Correct: Bitcoin, that was created in 2009, is famous.
squares.a: Bitcoin, which was created in 2009, is famous.

squares.a: e.g. A scam is a project that promises 100% profit a week.

squares.a: The man who sold me the coin was a scammer.

squares.a: e.g. An app which I use every day is Telegram. I use it to…

squares.a: e.g. A blockchain is a list of blocks which everyone can check.

squares.a: This is the exchange (which/that) I trade on.

squares.a: My uncle, who is a trader, lives in Bukhara.

squares.t: Define 'investor' with 'a person who…'.
squares.a: e.g. An investor is a person who puts money into a project to earn more.

squares.t: Join with commas: Satoshi is unknown. He invented Bitcoin.
squares.a: Satoshi, who invented Bitcoin, is unknown.

squares.a: e.g. What is the app which you use most?

15.title: Dominoes: crypto definitions with who / which / that
15.stage: Kripto CORE 20 lug'atidan keyin, Kombinatsiya bosqichida: ta'rif + who / which (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
15.goal: Kripto so'zining ta'rifini to'g'ri relative clause bilan ulash: odam → who, narsa → which / that; vergulli gapda which.
rules: Har guruhga bitta to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi gap boshi ('A miner is a person…') qaysi toshdagi davom bilan ulanadi — toping.
Maslahat: odam bo'lsa davomi who bilan, narsa bo'lsa which / that bilan boshlanadi; keyin ma'nosini tekshiring.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

15.goal: Kripto so'zlarini inglizcha tushuntirish — iloji boricha relative clause bilan: 'It's a person who…', 'It's a thing which…'.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi: so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Tushuntirishni 'It's a person who…' yoki 'It's a thing which…' bilan boshlash tavsiya etiladi — shunday gap uchun +1 bonus.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z yoki o'zbekcha so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

15.title: Find someone who… knows a person who trades crypto

15.goal: Ichida who / which / that bo'lgan savol tuzish (Do you have a friend who…? Do you use an app which…?) va javob berish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Do you have a friend who trades crypto?). Savolda who / which tushib qolmasligi kerak.

Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 3 ta natijani relative clause bilan aytib beradi: 'Aziz has a friend who…'.

16.title: Dominoes: e-commerce words with where / which
16.stage: E-commerce CORE 20 lug'atidan keyin, Kombinatsiyada: where / which / in which (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
16.goal: E-commerce so'zining ta'rifini to'g'ri relative clause bilan ulash: joy + where + ega + fe'l; narsa + which + fe'l; in / at / for which; vaqt + when.
rules: Har guruhga bitta to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi gap boshi ('A marketplace is a platform…') qaysi toshdagi davom bilan ulanadi — toping.
Maslahat: davom where + ega + fe'l bo'lsa — joy; which + fe'l bo'lsa — narsa; who — odam; when — vaqt. Keyin ma'nosini tekshiring.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; zanjir FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

16.goal: E-commerce so'zlarini inglizcha tushuntirish — iloji boricha 'It's a place where…', 'It's a thing which…' qoliplari bilan.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi: so'zning o'zi va kartadagi 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Joy bo'lsa 'It's a place where…', narsa bo'lsa 'It's a thing which…' bilan boshlash tavsiya etiladi — to'g'ri qolip uchun +1 bonus.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z yoki o'zbekcha so'z aytilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

16.goal: Ichida where / which bo'lgan savol tuzish (Do you know a shop where…? Have you ever returned a product which…?) va javob berish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi (masalan: Do you know a shop where you can buy cheap phones?).

Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va 3 ta natijani where / which bilan aytib beradi: 'Madina knows a shop where…'.

18.title: Grammar Auction: What he earns is a secret
18.stage: YANGI MAVZU (ega ergash gaplar) tushuntirilgandan keyin, Kombinatsiyadan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
18.goal: Ega ergash gaplarni (What / How / Whether / That / Whoever / Whatever + gap) tekshirish: birlik fe'l, savol tartibi yo'qligi, if emas whether, ortiqcha 'it' xatolarini topib tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: ega ergash gap to'g'ri tuzilganmi, asosiy fe'l birlikdami?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: What does she spend → What she spends, are → is, If → Whether).
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

18.title: Board Game: What I need is a budget

18.goal: Ega ergash gapni tanlash va tuzish, xatolarni tuzatish (savol tartibi, birlik fe'l, if/whether), 'It is … that' ni 'That … is' ga aylantirish va moliya mavzusida gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: har doim to'liq gap aytadi.
'Correct' katagida xatoni topadi: savol tartibi (does/did) olib tashlanadi, asosiy fe'l birlik bo'ladi, whoever'dan keyin -s qo'shiladi, if → whether, ortiqcha 'it' olib tashlanadi.
'Finish' kataklarida gapni mantiqli davom ettiradi; 'Talk' va 'Say' kataklarida gapni ega ergash gap bilan boshlaydi (What I… is…, Whoever…, Whether… depends on…).
Guruh a'zolari tekshiradi; shubha bo'lsa ustoz javob kalitiga qaraydi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

19.title: Grammar Auction: I don't know where she lives
19.stage: YANGI MAVZU (object clauses) tushuntirilgandan keyin, lug'at bosqichidan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
19.goal: To'ldiruvchi ergash gaplarni (that / where, why, how / if, whether / whatever) to'g'ri va xato ishlatilganini ajratish: ergash gapda savol tartibi yo'q, does/did tushadi, said dan keyin zamon orqaga suriladi.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: where/why/if dan keyin tartib 'ega + fe'l'mi? does/did ortiqcha emasmi? said dan keyin zamon to'g'rimi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi, lekin sababini aytishi shart (masalan: 'savol tartibi yo'q: where the ice goes').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Scientists say that the planet is getting warmer every year.
items.why: says (hozirgi) → zamon o'zgarmaydi: that + ega + fe'l.

items.s: I don't know where does the melted ice go.
items.fix: I don't know where the melted ice goes.
items.why: Ergash gapda savol tartibi yo'q: does tushadi, fe'lga -s qo'shiladi → where the melted ice goes.

items.s: Can you explain how the greenhouse effect works?
items.why: how + ega + fe'l (the effect works); 'does' kerak emas.

items.s: I don't understand why did the farmers leave their village.
items.fix: I don't understand why the farmers left their village.
items.why: did tushib qoladi, fe'l V2 bo'ladi: why the farmers left.

items.s: Nobody knows whether the Aral Sea will ever come back.
items.why: …mi-yo'qmi → whether + ega + fe'l (the Aral Sea will come).

items.s: I don't know that the river will flood or not.
items.fix: I don't know if/whether the river will flood.
items.why: Ikki imkoniyat (…mi-yo'qmi) → if/whether; 'that … or not' emas.

items.s: You can recycle whatever you don't need.
items.why: whatever — har qanday narsa (buyum uchun); odam uchun whoever.

items.s: Do you know where is the nearest recycling point?
items.fix: Do you know where the nearest recycling point is?
items.why: Ergash gapda ega fe'ldan oldin: where + the point + is.

items.s: I wonder if next summer will be as hot as this one.
items.why: if (…mi) + ega + fe'l: if next summer will be.

items.s: Scientists aren't sure when will the drought end.
items.fix: Scientists aren't sure when the drought will end.
items.why: when + ega + fe'l: when the drought will end (will ega oldiga chiqmaydi).

items.s: Last summer the farmer said that his well is dry, but now it is full of water.
items.fix: Last summer the farmer said that his well was dry, but now it is full of water.
items.why: said (o'tgan) va holat o'zgargan → zamon orqaga: is → was.

items.s: My grandmother told me that the winters were colder when she was young.
items.why: told (o'tgan) → zamon orqaga: were; told + odam + that.

19.title: Board Game: Do you know why the ice is melting?
19.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin yoki ularning bir qismi o'rniga, Reading'dan oldin (20 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
19.goal: Savolni to'ldiruvchi ergash gapga aylantirish (I don't know where…, I wonder if…), said dan keyin zamonni orqaga surish va iqlim o'zgarishi mavzusida og'zaki gap tuzish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: to'liq gap aytadi.

'Join' kataklarida ikki gap bitta gapga birlashtiriladi: ergash gapda do/does/did bo'lmaydi, ega fe'ldan oldin turadi. 'Report' kataklarida said dan keyin zamon orqaga suriladi (is → was, will → would).
Guruh a'zolari javobni tekshiradi; shubha bo'lsa ustozdan so'raladi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

19.title: Dominoes: direct question → object clause
19.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida: savol va ergash gap tartibini mustahkamlash (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
19.goal: To'g'ri savol yoki gapni (Where does the ice go?) uning to'ldiruvchi ergash gapli shakli (I don't know where the ice goes) bilan ulash: savol tartibi yo'qoladi, do/does/did tushadi, said dan keyin zamon orqaga suriladi.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi savol yoki gap qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi ergash gapli shaklga mos — toping.
Mos kelish sharti: ma'no bir xil, lekin ergash gapda ega + fe'l tartibi (where the ice goes, if it will rain), kerak bo'lsa V2 (why the lake dried up) yoki said dan keyin was/would.
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

19.title: Taboo: climate change words
19.stage: Climate change CORE 20 lug'at bosqichidan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.

rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Yordamchi qoliplar: 'It's what happens when…', 'I think that it…', 'Scientists say that it…'.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqibga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

19.goal: To'ldiruvchi ergash gapli savollar tuzish (Do you know what…? Can you explain why…? Do you think that…?) va iqlim o'zgarishi mavzusida javob berish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi: 'Do you know where the nearest recycling point is?' ('…where is the…' emas).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va isbot so'raydi: 'OK, tell me what it is / why it happened.'
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijani ergash gap bilan aytadi: 'Aziz knows why the Aral Sea dried up.'

Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi, lekin qoidani aytishi shart (masalan: 'enjoy + V-ing', 'predlog + V-ing').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi.
'Say the … gerund' kataklarida faqat shakl aytiladi; 'Fill', 'Correct' va 'Talk' kataklarida to'liq gap aytiladi.

20.title: Dominoes: afraid of being chased, good at hiding
20.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida: fe'l/predlog + gerund bog'lanishini mustahkamlash (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
20.goal: Gerund oldidagi to'g'ri predlogni (good at, afraid of, succeed in, stop … from, look forward to) va ma'noga mos gerund shaklini (V-ing / being + V3 / having + V3 / having been + V3) tanlab, gap bo'laklarini ulash.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi gap boshi qaysi toshning chap tomonidagi davomga ulanadi — toping.
Tekshirish: predlog to'g'rimi (good AT, afraid OF, succeed IN, look forward TO)? Faol yoki passiv shakl ma'noga mosmi (being treated — uni davolashgan)?
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato ulangan bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

20.title: Taboo: wildlife conservation
20.stage: Wildlife CORE 20 lug'at bosqichidan keyin yoki keyingi dars boshida takror (10 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
20.goal: Yovvoyi tabiatni muhofaza qilish so'zlarini (habitat, poacher, predator, captivity, ranger…) inglizcha tushuntirish; iloji bo'lsa gerund bilan: 'It's a person whose job is protecting…', 'It's about keeping animals…'.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Yordamchi qoliplar: 'It's a person who is good at…', 'Its job is protecting…', 'It's about keeping…'.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball, keyingi kartaga o'tiladi. Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa — karta raqibga o'tadi.
Imo-ishora mumkin, lekin o'zbekcha gapirish mumkin emas. Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

20.goal: Gerundli savollar tuzish (Do you enjoy watching…? Are you interested in becoming…? Do you remember being taken…?) va hayotiy javob berish.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzib so'raydi: 'Are you interested in becoming a vet?' ('interested in become' emas).
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (Why? When? Where?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijani gerund bilan aytadi: 'Lola dreams of seeing a snow leopard.'

20.stage: Writing / speaking mini-vazifa bosqichida, 1 daqiqalik og'zaki javob sifatida (12 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolgani — takrorga.
20.goal: Yovvoyi tabiat va hayvonlar haqida 3–4 gapli javob berish, kamida 2 ta gerund ishlatish (I enjoy…, I'm interested in…, Keeping animals in zoos is…, I remember being…).
rules: Kartalarni teskari dasta qilib qo'ying. Birinchi o'quvchi karta oladi va savolni sherigiga o'qiydi.
Sherigi 3–4 gap bilan javob beradi va kamida 2 ta gerund ishlatadi (fe'ldan keyin, predlogdan keyin yoki ega sifatida).
Tinglovchi har bir to'g'ri gerund uchun +1 ball, passiv yoki perfect gerund (being taken, having seen) uchun +2 ball beradi.
Rollar almashadi. 12 daqiqadan keyin eng ko'p ball olgan o'quvchi g'olib.

20.goal: Gerundli gapda so'z tartibini to'g'ri tuzish: fe'l/predlog + gerund, passiv (being + V3) va perfect (having (been) + V3) shakllar.

Jamoa qo'lini ko'taradi; ustoz tekshiradi: to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball va keyingi konvert, xato bo'lsa — qayta teradi.

21.title: Grammar Auction: to do, to be done, to have done
21.stage: Yangi mavzu jadvali tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
21.goal: Infinitivning shakllari (to V1, to be V3, to be V-ing, to have V3, to have been V3), 'not to' va 'make + V1' bo'yicha xatoni topish va tuzatish; koinot mavzusidagi gaplar.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: har jamoada boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: infinitiv shakli to'g'ri tanlanganmi (faol/passiv, oddiy/davomli/perfect)?
Jamoalar navbat bilan narx aytadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p taklif qilgan jamoa gapni 'sotib oladi' va pulni varaqdan ayiradi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatib, sababini aytgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'last year — o'tgan ish, demak to have + V3').
12 gapdan keyin eng ko'p to'g'ri gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa.

items.s: Many children dream about space, but few manage to become astronauts.
items.why: manage + to V1: manage to become.

items.s: The rocket needs to check before every launch.

items.why: Raketani tekshirishadi (passiv) → to be + V3 (BrE: 'needs checking' ham to'g'ri).

items.s: He claims to see a UFO near Baikonur last year.

items.why: last year — oldin bo'lgan ish → to have + V3 (Perfect).

items.s: She decided to not apply for the space programme.
items.fix: She decided not to apply for the space programme.
items.why: Inkor: not + to V1 ('to not' emas).

items.s: The commander made the crew to wear their helmets.
items.fix: The commander made the crew wear their helmets.
items.why: make + ob'ekt + V1 ('to' qo'yilmaydi).

items.s: The new satellite is expected to be launched next spring.
items.why: Yo'ldoshni uchirishadi (passiv) → to be + V3.

items.s: Our class is proud to have been invited to the observatory.
items.why: Oldin taklif qilingan (passiv) → to have been + V3.

items.s: I hope becoming an astronomer one day.
items.fix: I hope to become an astronomer one day.
items.why: hope + to V1 (gerund emas).

items.s: Gagarin is known to have made one orbit of the Earth in 1961.
items.why: 1961-yilda bo'lgan ish → to have + V3 (Perfect).

items.s: The ISS is said to have built by 15 countries.
items.fix: The ISS is said to have been built by 15 countries.
items.why: Stansiyani qurishgan (passiv + oldin) → to have been + V3.

21.title: Board Game: Space Mission Infinitives
21.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin, guruhlarda og'zaki mustahkamlash (20 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
21.goal: Infinitiv shakllarini (to V1 / to be V3 / to be V-ing / to have V3 / to have been V3) og'zaki qo'llash, xatoni tuzatish va koinot mavzusida qisqa gapirish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar, fishkalar va javoblar varag'ini bering; javoblar varag'i guruhdagi 'hakam'da turadi.
O'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni ovoz chiqarib bajaradi: bo'sh joyga to'g'ri infinitivni qo'yadi, xatoni tuzatadi yoki to'liq gap aytadi.
Hakam javobni varaqdan tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi katagiga qaytadi. 'e.g.' bilan berilgan ochiq topshiriqlarda har qanday to'g'ri gap qabul qilinadi.
'Talk for 20/30 seconds' kataklarida kamida bitta infinitiv ishlatilishi shart, aks holda o'yinchi oldingi katagiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish). Hakam har 5 daqiqada almashadi.
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

21.title: Dominoes: Which infinitive comes next?
21.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida (formula → gap), sinf mashqlaridan oldin (12 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
21.goal: Fe'l yoki iboradan keyin qaysi infinitiv kelishini aniqlash: manage/hope → to V1, need/expect → to be V3, seem → to be V-ing, claim → to have V3, proud → to have been V3, make → V1.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshlarini bering va aralashtiring.

22.title: Grammar Auction: Trading is… / It is hard to…
22.stage: Yangi mavzu (gerund/infinitiv ega) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
22.goal: Gerund/infinitiv ega bilan birlik fe'l (is/has), 'It is + sifat + to V1', enjoy/avoid/mind + V-ing va afford/decide/plan + to V1 xatolarini topish; jahon iqtisodiyoti gaplari.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz gapni doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: ega to'g'rimi (V-ing + is, It is … to), fe'ldan keyin gerund yoki infinitiv to'g'ri tanlanganmi?
Jamoalar navbat bilan narx aytadi (kamida 50, qadam 50); eng ko'p taklif qilgan jamoa gapni sotib oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — pul qaytadi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib tuzatgan va qoidani aytgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'avoid + V-ing', 'gerund ega — birlik').
12 gapdan keyin eng ko'p to'g'ri gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib; teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa.

22.goal: Gerund/infinitiv egani, 'It is … to' tuzilmasini va gerund yoki infinitiv talab qiladigan fe'llarni (enjoy, avoid, decide, afford, stop, remember, try) og'zaki qo'llash.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar, fishkalar va javoblar varag'ini bering; javoblar varag'i guruhdagi 'hakam'da turadi.
O'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni ovoz chiqarib bajaradi: bo'sh joyni V-ing yoki to V1 bilan to'ldiradi, xatoni tuzatadi yoki to'liq gap aytadi.
Hakam javob varag'i bo'yicha tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi katagiga qaytadi. 'e.g.' bilan berilgan javoblarda har qanday to'g'ri gap qabul qilinadi.
'Talk for 20/30 seconds' kataklarida kamida bitta gerund ega (Saving money is…) yoki 'It is … to' gap ishlatilishi shart.
Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib; vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

22.title: Dominoes: -ing or to? / It is … to …
22.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida (formula → gap → tarjima), sinf mashqlaridan oldin (12 daqiqa); ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi
22.goal: Gerund ega gapni 'It is … to …' shakliga moslash va fe'ldan keyin to'g'ri shaklni tanlash: mind/enjoy/stop (to'xtatish)/remember (o'tgan) + V-ing; afford/agree/stop (maqsad)/remember (kelajak) + to V1.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshlarini bering va aralashtiring.
START toshidan boshlang: uning o'ng yarmidagi qism qaysi toshning chap yarmi bilan to'g'ri birikadi — toping.
Ikki xil ulanish bor: (1) gerund egali gap → xuddi shu ma'nodagi 'It is … to …' gap; (2) gap boshi → uning to'g'ri davomi (V-ing yoki to V1).
Ma'noga ham qarang: stop + V-ing = to'xtatdi, stop + to V1 = …ish uchun to'xtadi; remember + V-ing = eslaydi, remember + to V1 = unutmaslik.
Zanjir FINISH bilan tugaydi. Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi, to'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing. Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: '-ing or to? 300').

23.title: Grammar Auction: have something done (causative)
23.stage: YANGI MAVZU (kauzativ jadvali) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
23.goal: Kauzativ gaplarni (have/get + ob'ekt + V3) barcha zamonlarda to'g'ri yoki xato ekanini ajratish: V1 o'rniga V3, ob'ektning o'rni, have + odam + V1, get + odam + to V1, salbiy tajriba (had his phone stolen).
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz ferma va kundalik hayot haqidagi gapni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: kauzativ gap to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi. Tekshiruv savollari: ob'ekt have va V3 orasidami? Fe'l V3 shaklidami? get + odam dan keyin 'to' bormi, have + odam dan keyin 'to' yo'qmi?
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Every spring the farmer has his fields ploughed by a neighbour.

items.fix: My uncle can't fix engines, so he had his tractor repaired at a garage.
items.why: Ustaxonada boshqa odam ta'mirlagan: ob'ekt had va V3 orasida turadi.

items.why: get + odam + to V1: got my brother to help.

items.why: Past Perfect kauzativ: had had + ob'ekt + V3 — 'had had' xato emas.

items.fix: I had the mechanic fix the irrigation pump.

23.title: Board Game: Have it done on the farm
23.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin yoki 24-dars boshida takror sifatida (20 daqiqa)
23.goal: Oddiy gapni kauzativga aylantirish (barcha zamonlarda), V3 shakllari, xato gaplarni tuzatish, have + odam + V1 / get + odam + to V1 va ferma mavzusida og'zaki gap tuzish.
rules: Har guruhga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
Navbati kelgan o'yinchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: gapni kauzativ bilan TO'LIQ aytadi (masalan: 'We had our tractor fixed.').
Qavsdagi so'z (I …, We …, He …) gap nima bilan boshlanishini ko'rsatadi. Zamon saqlanadi va have shaklida ko'rinadi: has / had / will have / are having / have had / had had.
Guruh tekshiradi: ob'ekt have va V3 orasidami, V3 to'g'rimi? Shubha bo'lsa — ustozdan so'raladi. Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi joyiga qaytadi.
Pushti kataklarda yozilgan buyruq bajariladi (oldinga, orqaga, navbat o'tkazish).
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan g'olib.

23.title: Dominoes: have it done — V3, V1 or to V1?
23.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 bosqichida — 1-mashq (kauzativ zamonlar) o'rniga yoki undan keyin (12 daqiqa)
23.goal: Kauzativ gap boshini (zamon + have/get + ob'ekt yoki odam) grammatik va mantiqan to'g'ri davom bilan ulash: narsa → V3, have + odam → V1, get + odam → to V1.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshini stolga qo'ying. Uning o'ng tomonidagi gap boshini qaysi davom to'g'ri va mantiqan tugatishini toping — o'sha davom chap tomonida yozilgan toshni ulang.

Maslahat: have + NARSA → V3 (have the soil tested); have + ODAM → V1 (had the vet check); get + ODAM → to V1 (got my cousin to help). Zamon so'zlariga ham qarang (at the moment, when the storm started).
Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulab boring; oxiri FINISH bilan tugashi kerak.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh butun zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; ustoz tekshiradi. Xato bo'lsa — keyingi guruh o'qiydi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

23.title: Taboo: organic farming
23.stage: 'Organic farming — CORE 20' lug'at bosqichidan keyin (10 daqiqa)
23.goal: Organik dehqonchilik so'zlarini (soil, harvest, compost, pesticide, crop rotation, orchard…) inglizcha tushuntirish va topish; tushuntirishda kauzativ ishlatish.
rules: Sinfni 2 jamoaga bo'ling. Jamoadan bitta o'quvchi chiqib, kartani oladi.
60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.
Jamoa topsa +1 ball. Tushuntiruvchi kamida bitta kauzativ gap ishlatsa (masalan: 'Farmers have it tested before planting.') — yana +1 bonus.
Taqiqlangan so'z aytilsa yoki o'zbekcha gapirilsa — karta raqib jamoaga o'tadi.
Kartalar tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

23.title: Find someone who… has had something done
23.stage: Kombinatsiya bosqichida — dars o'rtasida harakatli mashq (10 daqiqa)
23.goal: Kauzativ bilan savol tuzish turli zamonlarda (Do you have…? / Did you have…? / Have you had…? / Are you having…?) va get + odam + to V1, have + odam + V1.
rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari kauzativ bilan tuzib so'raydi (masalan: 'Do you have your hair cut every month?').
Zamonga e'tibor bering: har oy → Do you have…?; o'tgan yil → Did you have…?; hayotda / yaqinda → Have you had…?; hozir → Are you having…?
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha savol beradi (Where did you have it done? Who fixed it?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni kauzativ bilan aytadi: 'Aziz had his phone repaired last year.'

24.title: Grammar Auction: Could you tell me who wrote it?
24.stage: YANGI MAVZU (bilvosita savol jadvali) tushuntirilgandan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi.
24.goal: Bilvosita savollarni to'g'ri yoki xato ekanini ajratish: gapdek tartib (ega + fe'l), do/does/did yo'qolishi, passiv va Perfect, if/whether + could, Would you mind + V-ing, I'd be grateful if you could…
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000.
Ustoz kutubxona va adabiyot haqidagi savolni doskaga yozadi yoki o'qiydi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: bilvosita savol to'g'rimi yoki xato?
Jamoalar savolni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa uni oladi.
Savol TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — pul yo'qoladi.
Xato savolni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan jamoa +50 oladi. Tekshiruv: WH-so'zdan keyin ega + fe'l keladimi? did/does bormi? mind dan keyin V-ing, wondering dan keyin if + could bormi?
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI savol sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Could you tell me who wrote this poem?
items.why: who — ega, shuning uchun did kerak emas: who wrote.

items.why: Would you mind + V-ing: telling.

60 soniya ichida so'zni o'z jamoasiga inglizcha tushuntiradi — so'zning o'zi va 3 ta taqiqlangan so'z aytilmaydi.

rules: Har o'quvchiga so'rovnoma varag'ini bering. Hamma o'rnidan turadi.
O'quvchilar sinfda yurib, har qator uchun savolni o'zlari tuzadi — faqat MULOYIM bilvosita shaklda (masalan: 'Could you tell me whether you have read a fantasy novel this year?').
To'g'ridan-to'g'ri savol berilsa ('Have you read…?'), sherik javob bermaydi va 'Ask me politely, please!' deydi.
'Yes' degan odamning ismini yozadi va bitta qo'shimcha muloyim savol beradi (Would you mind telling me what it was called?).
Bitta odamning ismi ko'pi bilan 2 marta yozilishi mumkin.
Birinchi bo'lib 8 qatorni to'ldirgan o'quvchi 'Stop!' deydi va natijalarni sinfga aytib beradi.

25.stage: 'YANGI MAVZU' (Participle 1 / 2) dan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz darsga 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolganlari takrorga.
25.goal: Participle 1 (V-ing, faol) va Participle 2 (V3, passiv) ni ot oldida va otdan keyin to'g'ri tanlash; which qisqartirish, -ing/-ed his-tuyg'u sifatlari va having + V3 xatolarini tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000. Doskaga yozing: V-ing = faol (ot ishni o'zi qiladi), V3 = passiv (ish otga nisbatan qilingan).
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: sifatdosh shakli (V-ing / V3 / having + V3 / being + V3) to'g'rimi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan va sababini aytgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'qiz o'zi o'tiradi — faol, shuning uchun sitting').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

26.title: Grammar Auction: will → would (Future in the Past)
26.stage: 'YANGI MAVZU' (Future in the Past) dan keyin, sinf mashqlaridan oldin (15 daqiqa). Ustoz 1–3 o'yin tanlaydi, qolganlari yakuniy takrorga.
26.goal: Future in the Past: would + V1, would be + V-ing, would have + V3, would have been + V-ing va was/were going to shakllarini ajratish; will → would xatolarini tuzatish.
rules: Har jamoaga auksion varag'ini bering: boshlang'ich pul — 1000. Doskaga 4 qolipni yozing: would + V1 | would be + V-ing | would have + V3 | would have been + V-ing (+ was/were going to).
Ustoz gapni o'qiydi yoki doskaga yozadi. Jamoalar 30 soniya maslahatlashadi: asosiy gap o'tgan zamonda bo'lsa — would to'g'ri ishlatilganmi, shakl to'liqmi?
Jamoalar gapni 'sotib olish' uchun pul tikadi (kamida 50, qadam 50). Eng ko'p tikgan jamoa gapni oladi.
Gap TO'G'RI bo'lsa — jamoa tikkan pulini qaytarib oladi va +100 bonus; XATO bo'lsa — tikilgan pul yo'qoladi.
Xato gapni birinchi bo'lib to'g'ri tuzatgan va qoidani aytgan jamoa +50 oladi (masalan: 'said o'tgan zamonda — will emas, would').
Oxirida eng ko'p TO'G'RI gap sotib olgan jamoa g'olib (teng bo'lsa — puli ko'p jamoa).

items.s: Last year our coach said that our team would win the city cup.
items.why: said (o'tgan) → will emas, would + V1: would win.

items.s: I knew that I will pass the final test.
items.fix: I knew that I would pass the final test.
items.why: Asosiy gap o'tgan (knew) → would.

items.s: She promised she would be waiting for us at the stadium at 7.
items.why: Aniq vaqtda davom etadigan ish → would be + V-ing.

items.s: He thought he would finished the essay by Friday.
items.fix: He thought he would have finished the essay by Friday.
items.why: would dan keyin V3 kelmaydi: by Friday (muddat) → would have finished; would finish ham to'g'ri.

items.s: They were going visit Samarkand, but it rained.
items.fix: They were going to visit Samarkand, but it rained.
items.why: was/were going TO + V1 — 'to' tushib qolmaydi.

items.s: He said that by June he would have been studying English for a year.
items.why: by June + for a year → would have been + V-ing.

items.s: The captain said they would training in Turkey in March.
items.fix: The captain said they would be training in Turkey in March.
items.why: Davomli shakl: would BE + V-ing ('be' tushib qolmaydi); would train ham to'g'ri.

items.s: Nobody knew that the underdog would win the final.
items.why: knew (o'tgan) → would + V1: would win.

items.s: The weather forecast said it would rain the next day.
items.why: Reported speech: will → would, tomorrow → the next day.

items.s: He said he will call me the next day, but he didn't.
items.fix: He said he would call me the next day, but he didn't.
items.why: said (o'tgan) → will emas, would.

items.s: I was going to watch the match, but the electricity went off.
items.why: O'tgandagi amalga oshmagan reja → was going to + V1.

items.s: She said she would have been work for ten hours by 8 pm.
items.fix: She said she would have been working for ten hours by 8 pm.
items.why: would have been + V-ing: working.

26.title: Board Game: would + IELTS 3.0 revision
26.stage: Sinf mashqlari 1–6 dan keyin — would shakllari va butun kurs grammatikasi takrori (20 daqiqa)
26.goal: Future in the Past shakllari va reported speech (will → would) ni og'zaki ishlatish + IELTS 3.0 grammatikasini (tags, used to, must have, whose, kauzativ, bilvosita savol, sifatdosh) takrorlash.
rules: Har 3–4 o'quvchiga taxta, zar va fishkalar bering. Hamma START katagidan boshlaydi.
O'quvchi zar tashlaydi va katakdagi topshiriqni bajaradi: bo'shliqni to'ldiradi, gapni 'said / thought' bilan ko'chiradi, xatoni tuzatadi yoki gapiradi.
'Revision (L…)' kataklari — kursning o'sha darsi grammatikasi. To'g'ri javob bergan o'yinchi bonus sifatida yana 1 katak oldinga yuradi.
Guruh javobni kalit bilan tekshiradi (kalit guruh sardorida). Xato bo'lsa — o'yinchi oldingi katagiga qaytadi.
'Talk for 20/30 seconds' kataklarida kamida 3 gap va kamida 1 ta would / was going to bo'lishi shart. Pushti kataklardagi buyruq bajariladi.
FINISH ga birinchi yetgan o'yinchi g'olib. Vaqt tugasa — eng oldinda turgan o'yinchi g'olib.

26.title: Dominoes: "I'll call you" → He said he would call me
26.stage: 'Kombinatsiya' bosqichida — will → would ko'chirishni mustahkamlash (12 daqiqa)
26.goal: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri gapni o'tgan zamondagi kelajakka ko'chirish: will → would, will be → would be, will have → would have, am going to → was going to; olmosh va vaqt so'zlari o'zgarishi.
rules: Har guruhga bir to'plam domino toshi bering va aralashtiring.
START toshidan boshlang: o'ng tomondagi ko'chirma gapga (masalan: "I'll call you at 6," he said.) mos o'zlashtirma gapni (He said he would…) boshqa toshning chap tomonidan toping.
Shakl aniq mos bo'lishi shart: will call → would call, will be calling → would be calling, will have finished → would have finished, are going to → were going to.
Olmosh va vaqt so'zlariga ham qarang: I → he/she, we → they, tomorrow → the next day. Toshlarni zanjir qilib ulang; oxiri FINISH bilan tugaydi.
Birinchi tugatgan guruh zanjirni ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; xato bo'lsa — navbat keyingi guruhga o'tadi. To'g'ri tugatgan birinchi guruh g'olib.

He said he would be calling me at 6.

She said she would have finished it by Monday.
"I'll finish it by Monday," she said.
She said she would finish it by Monday.

The coach said they were going to train in Turkey.

My teacher told me I would pass.

She promised she wouldn't be late.

The forecast said it would rain the next day.
"We'll have scored ten goals by May," he said.
He said they would have scored ten goals by May.
"Will you help me?" she asked.
She asked if I would help her.
"I'll be travelling in June," Eldor said.
Eldor said he would be travelling in June.

26.title: Sentence Race: Future in the Past

rules: Har jamoaga bitta konvert (bitta gapning so'zlari) beriladi.
Jamoa so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda teradi va gapdagi shaklni aytadi: would + V1, would be + V-ing, would have + V3, would have been + V-ing yoki was/were going to.
Yordam: gapning birinchi so'zi katta harf bilan, oxirgi so'zi nuqta yoki so'roq belgisi bilan yozilgan.
Ustoz tekshiradi: tartib va shakl nomi to'g'ri bo'lsa +1 ball, jamoa keyingi konvertni oladi.
Hamma konvertlar tugaganda eng ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib.

sentences: The coach said that Uzbekistan would qualify for the World Cup.
I knew I would pass the final test.
She said she would be waiting for us.
He thought he would have finished the essay by Friday.
They were going to visit Samarkand, but it rained.
He said he would have been working for ten hours by 8 pm.
Nobody knew that the underdog would win the final.
She promised she wouldn't be late again.
Did you think the course would be so useful?
My teacher told me I would need more practice.

26.title: Quiz Board: IELTS 3.0 final review
26.stage: Dars oxiridagi kurs yakuniy takrori; tanlanmagan o'yinlar yakuniy takror mashg'ulotida ishlatiladi (15 daqiqa)
26.goal: Future in the Past shakllari, IELTS 3.0 kursi grammatikasi (tags, kauzativ, bilvosita savol, must have, mixed conditional) va eng muhim so'zlarini o'yin shaklida yakuniy takrorlash.
rules: Taxtani doskaga chizing: 4 ustun (would forms, Course grammar, Course words, Say it!) va 100–500 ballar.
Jamoalar navbat bilan bo'lim va ballni tanlaydi (masalan: 'Course words 300'). Ustoz savolni o'qiydi.
Jamoa 20 soniyada javob beradi. To'g'ri — ball jamoaga; xato — boshqa jamoalar qo'l ko'tarib javob berishi mumkin.
'Say it!' savollarida javob to'liq gap bo'lishi va would / was going to to'g'ri ishlatilishi shart.
Ishlatilgan katak o'chiriladi. Hamma katak tugaganda ko'p ball olgan jamoa g'olib — kurs chempioni.

qs.q: What is the past form of 'will'?
Future Simple in the Past: He said he ___ (call) me.
Future Continuous in the Past: She said she ___ (wait) for us at 7.
Future Perfect in the Past: I thought I ___ (finish) the book by May.
Future Perfect Continuous in the Past: He said he ___ (work) for 10 hours by 8.
Add the tag: She's tech-savvy, …?
I had my laptop ___ yesterday. (fix)
Make it polite: 'Where is the bank?' → Could you tell me …?
qs.a: Could you tell me where the bank is?

qs.q: His bag isn't here. He ___ (must / leave) early.
Mixed conditional: If I ___ (study) harder last year, I would be fluent now.
Very good at using modern technology (adjective)
A plan of a journey with places and times
The team or player that is expected to lose
Animals or plants that may soon disappear forever
The ability to recover quickly from difficulties
Report: "I will help you," she said.
qs.a: She said she would help me.

qs.q: Say something you were going to do last weekend but didn't.
qs.a: e.g. I was going to play football, but it rained.

qs.q: Report: "I'll be waiting at the stadium," he said.
qs.a: He said he would be waiting at the stadium.

qs.q: Correct it: I knew that I will pass.
qs.a: I knew that I would pass.

qs.q: At the start of this course, what did you think you would have done by now? (would have + V3)
qs.a: e.g. I thought I would have learned 500 words by now.
